npc.orwyn.personality: Gruff and gentle: a retired sage who hides his worry behind chores.
chat.orwyn.1: Your grandfather was never a hero, you know. Just the man who stayed put when it mattered.
chat.orwyn.2: Heroes leave. Elders stay and mend the roof. Both are needed.
chat.orwyn.3: If the crystal glows, it will frighten them. Let them be frightened. Fear fades faster than shame.
greet.orwyn.v0.1: The Crown is light again. I always said you would outgrow my sword.
greet.orwyn.v1.1: You are carrying it better than I did. Keep your friends close.
greet.orwyn.v2.1: I am only an echo now, boy. Walk on. You are carrying more than you think.
greet.orwyn.v3.1: Chores before the ceremony, {player_name}. The crystal judges the heart, not the hour you wake. Fetch the water, then we walk to the shrine together.
npc.tilly.personality: Quick-witted, loyal, and the only one who never treated {player_name} like a weapon.
chat.tilly.1: You still scare me a little. Not the glow. The way you stop talking when it happens.
chat.tilly.2: I don't care how strong you get. You're still the idiot who fell in the millpond.
chat.tilly.3: Promise me you'll write. Or send a rock with a note. Rocks are reliable.
greet.tilly.v0.1: Ashbrook has a bakery again! Don't tell anyone, but I stole the recipe from you. You burn everything.
greet.tilly.v1.1: The camp is a village again, almost. Orphans in the hay loft, a roof on the mill. You'd hardly know it burned.
greet.tilly.v2.1: I'm running the refugee camp now. Somebody has to. You go be a hero; I'll make sure the soup is hot when you're back.
greet.tilly.v3.1: There you are! You missed breakfast and half the chores. Don't think the ceremony gets you out of mucking the stable.
npc.haldor.personality: Fussy about protocol, secretly terrified of the day a crystal would answer.
chat.haldor.1: Three hundred years since the last S-rank. The records of that one are... missing. Odd, is it not?
chat.haldor.2: I asked Archbishop Caldrin. He told me to stop asking.
chat.haldor.3: I stopped. That is my shame.
greet.haldor.v0.1: I rebuilt the shrine with the survivors. We left the cracked crystal in the wall. It reminds me to be brave.
greet.haldor.v1.1: The Church is not what I thought it was. I mean to find out what I have been serving.
greet.haldor.v2.1: I conducted the ceremony. I saw the gold. I have not slept right since. Forgive me for looking at you as if you were a storm.
greet.haldor.v3.1: Ah, {player_name}. Today is the Awakening. Stand straight, speak only when spoken to, and for the dawn's sake do not touch the crystal until I say.
npc.mira.personality: A small orphan who collects shiny things and unspoken promises.
chat.mira.1: My wishing star is called Pebble. It fell in the well. Can you find it?
chat.mira.2: If you find Pebble, I'll tell you a secret. Okay? Okay.
chat.mira.3: (She whispers) The old lady at the library said a hero cried here once, a long time ago.
greet.mira.v0.1: I wished on a star and you won. I think I'm good at wishing.
greet.mira.v1.1: You came back! Everyone says you're going to win. Did you tell the sky?
greet.mira.v2.1: Tilly says you're busy saving the world. I'm busy too. I'm counting stars. There are a lot of them.
greet.mira.v3.1: Are you the hero? You don't look like a hero. You look tired. Do you want my shiny rock?
npc.hanna.personality: Stern and unsentimental; her care shows up as extra paperwork.
chat.hanna.1: I have signed fifty-three death notices for adventurers who thought they could do it alone.
chat.hanna.2: Half of them were better swordsmen than you.
chat.hanna.3: That is not an insult. It is a schedule. Make friends before you need them.
greet.hanna.v0.1: The Guild has never had an S-rank retire. I'm putting in the paperwork anyway.
greet.hanna.v1.1: I should have burned that Archbishop's ledgers years ago. Not your fault. Mine.
greet.hanna.v2.1: You wear S-rank like armor now. Armor has weight. Come to me when it chafes.
greet.hanna.v3.1: Sit. No, not there, that's Pip's chair. Strong heroes die alone, {player_name}. Remember that, and you may outlive your own legend.
npc.pip.personality: Talks faster than he thinks, files faster than he talks, and lost a ledger once. Once.
chat.pip.1: Did you know the guild board gets a new bounty every sunrise? I post them. With my own hands. Mostly.
chat.pip.2: My ledger is somewhere in the city. It has the only record of every rank-up. Don't tell Hanna.
greet.pip.v0.1: Business is booming! Heroes everywhere. Somebody please take my paperwork.
greet.pip.v1.1: Everyone's lining up for bounties. I haven't had lunch in a week. A week! Eat something, hero.
greet.pip.v2.1: S-rank! I asked for a bigger desk the day you got promoted. They said no. Pity.
greet.pip.v3.1: Welcome to the Adventurer Guild! New? Rank? Name? Favorite color? Don't answer that last one, it's not on the form but I'm curious!
npc.garrick.personality: Burly and brusque; speaks to metal more gently than to customers.
chat.garrick.1: Every sword has a temper. Mine learned from me. Yours learned from your grandfather. Treat it kindly.
chat.garrick.2: Your 'Dawnbrand'? Plain iron, good balance, honest blade. They don't make them that way for the show.
chat.garrick.3: Whatever fire you put in it later is your business.
greet.garrick.v0.1: Forge is hot, ale is cold. Come by when you want that sword upgraded.
greet.garrick.v1.1: Brandt Cinder in Emberforge sent a letter. Says I'm slacking. I'm not. I'm resting between masterpieces.
greet.garrick.v2.1: S-rank hands deserve S-rank steel. Bring me the rare ore I asked about, would you?
greet.garrick.v3.1: Mind the anvil. Iron, steel, whatever you've got: I turn it into something that keeps you alive.
npc.selwyn.personality: A silver-tongued gossip who knows every secret in Aurelheim and sells most of them.
chat.selwyn.1: Moonpetal, desert bloom, frostcap, ashroot... every tonic needs a region's soul in it.
chat.selwyn.2: The trick is to pick the herb while it still believes it will live.
chat.selwyn.3: That is not an alchemical rule. I just say it to sound mysterious.
greet.selwyn.v0.1: Business is lovely. Heroes drink a lot of potions. Heroes also owe me money. Don't take it personally.
greet.selwyn.v1.1: Everyone's gossip is turning grim, dear. Archbishop's been arrested. I knew it. I didn't tell you because you'd have asked how.
greet.selwyn.v2.1: The whole city's talking about you. The tavern says you're nine feet tall. I told them you're taller.
greet.selwyn.v3.1: Darling, you look dreadful. Sit. Buy a potion. Hear a rumor. In that order, preferably.
npc.darius.personality: Proud, sarcastic, trained since birth; beaten by a farm boy and furious about how much he respects it.
chat.darius.1: My father thinks a Valecrest should be first. Second place is a family scandal.
chat.darius.2: I train at dawn so nobody can see me bleed. You turned up at dawn once. Annoying.
chat.darius.3: Don't tell anyone, but you were the first person who beat me and didn't gloat. It's unnerving.
greet.darius.v0.1: Guildmaster's apprentice. Don't laugh. I'm very good at paperwork. It's like fencing, but nobody gets stabbed.
greet.darius.v1.1: I owe you. I hate saying that. Do not make me say it twice.
greet.darius.v2.1: I want a rematch. Not for revenge. For... accuracy. Fine. Revenge a little.
greet.darius.v3.1: Well, if it isn't the farm boy. Try not to trip over your own sword. It'd be embarrassing for both of us.
npc.caldrin.personality: Warm, patient, endlessly reasonable: the kind of man who explains why the price is worth paying.
chat.caldrin.1: Faith is a currency, my boy. Someone must tend the treasury.
chat.caldrin.2: Mirelle is our brightest light. I would never ask more of her than the dawn asks of the sun.
chat.caldrin.3: ...Forgive me. I am old. My metaphors get away from me.
greet.caldrin.v0.1: (The cell door is closed. They say he still smiles.)
greet.caldrin.v1.1: (He is not here. The cathedral smells of cold candles.)
greet.caldrin.v2.1: So much hope rests on you. Come, let me bless the blade that bears it.
greet.caldrin.v3.1: Child of the dawn, you honor us. The Church is always grateful for a hero who knows the value of sacrifice.
npc.dunmore.personality: Disciplined and dry; commands the city watch like a woman who has seen a siege before.
chat.dunmore.1: I've drilled that watch for twenty years. I know which of them will hold a line and which will faint.
chat.dunmore.2: The ones who faint are usually the brave ones. They try.
greet.dunmore.v0.1: I'll lead the army to the Hollow Gate myself. No, you can't talk me out of it. Your friends are marching too.
greet.dunmore.v1.1: Give me ten minutes with the Archbishop's guards and I'll have the cathedral sealed. You're welcome.
greet.dunmore.v2.1: The city has locked down since the festival. I like it. Order suits me. You may pass, hero.
greet.dunmore.v3.1: Halt. Business in Aurelheim? State it. Briefly. I have a gate, a watch, and a headache.
npc.voss.personality: An elegant scholar who values reputation above everything except his regret.
chat.voss.1: Mana is not a talent. It is a river. Teach a student to swim, not to dam.
chat.voss.2: I taught Lyra to dam it. I regret that.
chat.voss.3: Magic is a language of trust. I was a poor grammarian.
greet.voss.v0.1: A new wing is under construction. Lyra's design. She tells me where the pillars go. I let her.
greet.voss.v1.1: I have reopened the east wing. It has her name on the door. Do not tell her. Let her find it.
greet.voss.v2.1: Lyra Vesperine was... a difficult student. Brilliant. I may have been wrong about her. I would say it to her face if she came back.
greet.voss.v3.1: The Spire Academy does not accept visitors. Unless they bring a good reason, a better introduction, and ideally a donation.
npc.fenn.personality: A hermit who talks to plants and finds people noisier.
chat.fenn.1: Dryads don't die. They fade into the grain of the wood. Vessara faded long before she fell.
chat.fenn.2: I knew her. Before the corruption. She sang to the saplings.
chat.fenn.3: If you meet her, be gentle. She is a mother, not a monster.
greet.fenn.v0.1: Come by whenever. Brought you a moonpetal tea. Don't say thank you. The moss gets jealous.
greet.fenn.v1.1: The corruption is receding. Roots remember the old song. I'm teaching it to the new ones.
greet.fenn.v2.1: The trees whisper your name. They whisper everyone's name, but yours louder. That's new.
greet.fenn.v3.1: Quiet. The moss is listening. State your business, or leave it with the stones.
npc.kharim.personality: A patient tribal elder with a laugh like a dust storm and the memory of every well in the desert.
chat.kharim.1: In my grandfather's time, the desert sang. Then a king-in-the-sands stole the song and hid it in glass.
chat.kharim.2: Khemet-Ur. They say he can unmake a minute.
chat.kharim.3: Be careful with your mistakes there. He keeps them.
greet.kharim.v0.1: You will always have a tent among us. And a camel. A very bad-tempered camel.
greet.kharim.v1.1: The hourglass is silent now. The sands have started to flow forward again. We do not know whether to cheer or weep.
greet.kharim.v2.1: The oasis tribes have agreed to guide you. Not for your sword. For the way you thanked the old woman at the well.
greet.kharim.v3.1: Peace to you, traveler. Sit; drink. The desert teaches haste is an insult to water.
npc.zaira.personality: A caravan merchant who treats every price as an opening line.
chat.zaira.1: Rare spices are like rumors: the best ones are older than the people telling them.
chat.zaira.2: I'm looking for a blend my grandmother made. The recipe is hidden in a mural in the Khemet ruins.
chat.zaira.3: Find it for me and I'll cook you a feast that ends wars.
greet.zaira.v0.1: You're family, so for you the price is only double.
greet.zaira.v1.1: The caravan roads are open again. More customers, more bandits, more fun.
greet.zaira.v2.1: The Hero of the Sands! I put your name on a bag of cumin. Triple the price. Don't be offended; it moves.
greet.zaira.v3.1: Traveler! You look like someone who needs spice. Everyone needs spice. Look, taste, argue, then buy.
npc.anwen.personality: A scholar who talks about the dead as if they were late for dinner.
chat.anwen.1: Look at this mural. A man in light, alone, facing a crowd of faceless shadows.
chat.anwen.2: Every kingdom has a story where one person bears the burden. Almost none of them say what happened afterward.
chat.anwen.3: Afterward is where the truth lives.
greet.anwen.v0.1: I'm cataloguing everything. Even the footprints. Especially yours.
greet.anwen.v1.1: Khemet-Ur is gone. The hourglass counts honestly again. I can finally date my own handwriting.
greet.anwen.v2.1: The murals show a lone hero standing at the center of every scene. The artists were paid to flatter or to warn. I haven't decided.
greet.anwen.v3.1: Careful where you step. This floor is four thousand years older than your family. Ask before you sneeze.
npc.torvik.personality: A mountain guide who sings to stay warm and lies about the weather.
chat.torvik.1: My daughter was a climber. She went up the Lighthouse and the mountain kept her.
chat.torvik.2: I don't blame the mountain. I blame myself for teaching her to love it.
chat.torvik.3: Whatever you do, don't fall in love with something you can't carry back down.
greet.torvik.v0.1: I'll take you up any peak you like. As long as it's not the one with the frozen lighthouse.
greet.torvik.v1.1: The Choir's silence ended. For a night the whole mountain sang. I wept like a baby. It was in tune.
greet.torvik.v2.1: Whiteout Pass is no joke. I know a route. It's slower. It is also not death.
greet.torvik.v3.1: Welcome to Hrimvald! The weather is lovely. By which I mean the wind only wants to kill you a little.
npc.elowen.personality: A cathedral caretaker who speaks in whispers and listens in full sentences.
chat.elowen.1: She was our choir mistress once. A singer so good the ice kept her voice.
chat.elowen.2: When the demons came, she sang to keep them out. It worked. It kept everyone else out too.
chat.elowen.3: Be gentle. She isn't evil. She's lonely.
greet.elowen.v0.1: I light a candle every morning for her. It seems the least I can do.
greet.elowen.v1.1: She is silent now. For the first time in three hundred years. I sat in the nave and listened to my own heartbeat.
greet.elowen.v2.1: Isrevna's songs mention the first light. I was told it was a hymn. I think it was a name.
greet.elowen.v3.1: Please lower your voice. The Choir Cathedral listens to everything, and it holds grudges.
npc.brandt.personality: The loudest man in Cinderhold, and the most careful with a hammer.
chat.brandt.1: There's a forge-song about a tired knight, you know. Old as the mountain. Nobody knows the last verse.
chat.brandt.2: My grandfather always said the knight forged a sword that never needed sharpening. Because he never put it down.
chat.brandt.3: Sad song. Good rhythm for hammering.
greet.brandt.v0.1: My apprentices will make a thousand blades. The war ended; the building didn't.
greet.brandt.v1.1: The forge hums again. The Singing Anvil! I can hear it at night. Like the hymns of my grandfather.
greet.brandt.v2.1: I'll forge the party's final weapons. All four. You'll have to hold off the volcano for a week. Think you can manage?
greet.brandt.v3.1: You have good bones for a blade! Bring me the best ore in the mines and I'll make you weapons the old kings would weep over.
npc.ysolde.personality: Leads the miners' guild with soot on her cheek and steel in her spine.
chat.ysolde.1: A miner knows the dark. We carry our own lamps and our own courage.
chat.ysolde.2: Your type goes into the dark and comes out a legend. We go in and come out with ore.
chat.ysolde.3: Both are work. Never forget that.
greet.ysolde.v0.1: My people are heroes too. Mark that in your journal.
greet.ysolde.v1.1: The strike ended. We got what we asked for. Not all of it. But enough to start asking again.
greet.ysolde.v2.1: The mines are rumbling. The eruption's near. I won't send my people down until it's safe. Don't try to argue.
greet.ysolde.v3.1: Fifteen-hour shifts, rockfall every week, pay that insults a mule. That's why I'm in charge. Somebody has to shout.
npc.nox.personality: A former cultist who sells information and keeps a ledger of his own sins.
chat.nox.1: I was a believer once. They told me the world was suffering and we alone could end it.
chat.nox.2: I left when I realized they had no plan for what comes after.
chat.nox.3: A cause that has no afterwards isn't mercy. It's an ending in a nice coat.
greet.nox.v0.1: I burned my ledger. All of it. I'm told this makes me a good man. I'm told I should keep a spare.
greet.nox.v1.1: I heard what happened at the throne. I'm not a believer in much. I almost believe in you.
greet.nox.v2.1: The cult is hollow, in the literal sense. The Hollow King's heart is a rumor. Pay up and I'll tell you what I know.
greet.nox.v3.1: Information has a price. So does silence. I sell both. Today, I'm feeling generous. Ask.
npc.edda.personality: A formidable politician who treats every petitioner as a negotiating partner.
chat.edda.1: Politics is just friendship with budgets.
chat.edda.2: I've seen three assassins, two plagues, and a wedding that lasted a month. The wedding was worse.
chat.edda.3: If you ever need a favor from the council, ask me before you ask the tribes. They like to bargain.
greet.edda.v0.1: Qasr Amun is yours for life. Not as a gift. As a lease.
greet.edda.v1.1: The council thanks you. In writing. In triplicate. With a small gift. That's how thanks work here.
greet.edda.v2.1: I've balanced the trade council for thirty years. Your arrival is the most disruptive thing since the drought. Welcome.
greet.edda.v3.1: The oasis feeds six tribes and one guild. Every sip is a political act. Do try to remember that when you ask for water.
npc.marek.personality: A mountain patrol captain who counts his people every sunrise and every sunset.
chat.marek.1: Avalanches announce themselves with a small sound, like someone clearing their throat.
chat.marek.2: If you hear it, run uphill. Counterintuitive. Lifesaving.
greet.marek.v0.1: I counted everyone this morning. All present. First time in two years.
greet.marek.v1.1: The Choir quieted. The wolves quieted. The mountain quiet is the loudest thing I've heard.
greet.marek.v2.1: We lost a team in the pass last week. If you find them, bring them home. Even if there's only a hat.
greet.marek.v3.1: Patrol is out. Avalanche warning. Stay inside unless you have a very good reason and a very good coat.
npc.lio.personality: A traveling bard who never stays, always knows the lyric, and remembers your last verse.
chat.lio.1: Every town has a song, and every song has a verse nobody sings.
chat.lio.2: In Cinderhold they hum one about a knight who never put down his sword.
chat.lio.3: In Frostspire, a choir about 'the first light.' Both end the same way, mid-sentence. Funny. Almost like someone ran out of breath.
greet.lio.v0.1: A new verse: and in the end he was not alone. I'm told it doesn't scan. I'm keeping it.
greet.lio.v1.1: They're singing it in every tavern. Nobody gets the words right. I gave up correcting them.
greet.lio.v2.1: I wrote a ballad about you. It has a rhyme for 'Ascendant.' I'm very proud. It doesn't rhyme.
greet.lio.v3.1: Ho, traveler! A song for a coin, a story for a seat by the fire. Which will it be?
npc.bram.personality: A guilt-ridden former captain who drinks to quiet a roll call only he can hear.
chat.bram.1: I ordered the retreat at Greywall. Saved ten thousand. Left forty behind.
chat.bram.2: They tell me that's a good trade. They don't hear the forty.
chat.bram.3: You want me to lift a shield again? Give me a reason I can carry.
greet.bram.v0.1: Greywall's names are on the wall. I read them out every morning. It helps.
greet.bram.v1.1: Behind me, kid. I'll hold the line. That's the one thing I do right.
greet.bram.v2.1: You again. Fine. You've got a stubborn jaw. Stubborn, I respect.
greet.bram.v3.1: Go away, kid. I'm not for hire. I'm not for anything. I'm for sitting here with a bottle and a bad memory.
npc.lyra.personality: A prodigy whose power outruns her patience; hiding because she believes she is a danger to everyone.
chat.lyra.1: I destroyed a wing of the Academy when I was fifteen. Seven injured. No one died. That's not the point.
chat.lyra.2: The point is I couldn't stop it. I tried. It just kept coming.
chat.lyra.3: If you're stronger than me, you've felt that. Haven't you?
greet.lyra.v0.1: I'm building an academy wing. With my name on it. Don't tell Voss it was my idea. He likes to think he thought of it.
greet.lyra.v1.1: My mana feels... quieter. Like someone is holding the other end of the rope.
greet.lyra.v2.1: You're the one with more raw power than me. Everyone says so. I'd like to see it. Don't hold back, or I'll be insulted.
greet.lyra.v3.1: Don't come closer. I mean it. The shelves are rattling, and I'm not the one doing it. Okay, I am. Go away.
npc.mirelle.personality: A radiant priestess whose smile never quite reaches the cost she pays for it.
chat.mirelle.1: I was five when the Church found me. They said I had a gift. I believed them.
chat.mirelle.2: I've healed hundreds. I don't mind giving. I mind that no one told me how much.
chat.mirelle.3: ...Please don't tell the others I said that.
greet.mirelle.v0.1: I took a day off. A whole day. I saw a market. I ate three pastries. I want to do it again.
greet.mirelle.v1.1: I'm learning a new kind of healing. One that doesn't take from me. Light will find a way.
greet.mirelle.v2.1: You noticed I'm tired. Most people don't. It's fine. The light provides.
greet.mirelle.v3.1: Blessings of the dawn, traveler. Are you hurt? Please, sit. It's no trouble. It's never trouble.
npc.marta.personality: Runs the Gilded Lantern with a ladle and an iron will.
chat.marta.1: Guests tell me everything. Heroes tell me nothing. It's disappointing.
chat.marta.2: Last winter a man left a sword at the bar and never came back. It's on the wall. Want to see it?
greet.marta.v0.1: The Lantern's full every night. I'm adding a second floor. Don't ask where I got the lumber.
greet.marta.v1.1: Half the city's been through here this month. Everyone's got a story. Mine's soup.
greet.marta.v2.1: Heroes eat for free if they promise not to break anything. I haven't had a free hero yet. You're the first.
greet.marta.v3.1: Room, meal, or both? Beds are clean, soup is hot, and I don't tolerate swords at the table.
npc.voll.personality: A bellowing drill sergeant who mistakes affection for volume.
chat.voll.1: Rule one of swordplay: don't die. Rule two: don't die while looking silly.
chat.voll.2: Rule three: ask someone behind you to watch your back. They always say yes. Be worth it.
greet.voll.v0.1: You never needed my training. I like to think it helped. Don't contradict me.
greet.voll.v0.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'sword trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.voll.v1.1: I trained half the watch and every guard on that wall. Not one of them died of bad footwork.
greet.voll.v1.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'sword trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.voll.v2.1: S-rank, huh? Doesn't excuse the elbows.
greet.voll.v2.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'sword trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.voll.v3.1: Recruit! Posture! Guard up! Your elbows are a disgrace. Ten laps, then we talk swordplay.
greet.voll.v3.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'sword trials' and come back with a story to tell.
npc.corin.personality: A nervous adept who explains everything three times and apologizes four.
chat.corin.1: Spells are like sentences. You can't shout them at a wall.
chat.corin.2: Well. You can. But the wall doesn't understand.
greet.corin.v0.1: Mana control is trust. Lyra taught me that. I think she'd say I'm doing well.
greet.corin.v0.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'magic trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.corin.v1.1: I've started giving lectures again. People attend. I'm shaking.
greet.corin.v1.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'magic trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.corin.v2.1: A hero in the library! Everyone's whispering. I'm whispering. Do you hear me whispering?
greet.corin.v2.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'magic trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.corin.v3.1: Oh! Hello! Mana theory is... well, you probably don't... sorry. Sorry! Lessons are on hold until Dean Voss clears the east wing.
greet.corin.v3.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'magic trials' and come back with a story to tell.
npc.perpetua.personality: A stern teacher of holy arts who believes compassion is a discipline.
chat.perpetua.1: Healing is the oldest craft. Everyone does it badly the first time.
greet.perpetua.v0.1: The order is reborn. Thank you. I'll bake you something, and you'll eat it.
greet.perpetua.v0.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'holy trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.perpetua.v1.1: New students arrive daily. They want to heal the world. I teach them to heal one person without breaking themselves.
greet.perpetua.v1.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'holy trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.perpetua.v2.1: I used to teach that the Tithe was a gift. I now teach that it was theft. I'm still angry.
greet.perpetua.v2.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'holy trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.perpetua.v3.1: Kneel if you must, but heal first. Prayers come after. The wounded can't wait for your poetry.
greet.perpetua.v3.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'holy trials' and come back with a story to tell.
npc.tavish.personality: A one-legged veteran who swears a shield is the finest weapon ever invented.
chat.tavish.1: A shield-man's duty is to stand. Everyone else gets to be clever.
chat.tavish.2: We get the ugly, necessary work. We'd have it no other way.
greet.tavish.v0.1: My leg may be gone but my stories aren't. Sit down.
greet.tavish.v0.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'shield trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.tavish.v1.1: Heard Bram's holding the line again. Warms an old man's leg.
greet.tavish.v1.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'shield trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.tavish.v2.1: Bram Ironvale. Aye, I know the name. Best shield-man in three generations. Tell him Tavish says he owes me a drink.
greet.tavish.v2.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'shield trials' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.tavish.v3.1: Hah! A shield's not just a wall, lad. It's a promise made of wood. Learn to hold it and the sword will follow.
greet.tavish.v3.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'shield trials' and come back with a story to tell.
npc.bao.personality: Feeds half of Aurelheim from one cart and refuses to share the recipe.
chat.bao.1: People think great cooking is about spice. It's about timing.
chat.bao.2: A hero who eats on time wins more battles. Fact. I have a chart.
greet.bao.v0.1: Lava-Fish Special? I'll make you a mild one. My stomach has limits.
greet.bao.v1.1: I cooked for the army. I'm cooking for the city. The pot never gets smaller; I do not know why.
greet.bao.v2.1: Hero's special! You get extra pork. Don't tell the others.
greet.bao.v3.1: Dumplings! Hot! Fresh! Three for a copper, five for a promise!
npc.wick.personality: Smells of hay, speaks to horses first and people second.
chat.wick.1: A good mount learns your temper before you do.
chat.wick.2: Be kind to them. They remember.
greet.wick.v0.1: I've named a foal after you. She's very fast and bites everyone. You'd get along.
greet.wick.v1.1: Roads are safer. The horses are less nervous. So am I.
greet.wick.v2.1: A mount for the desert, hero? The camels at Qasr Amun are the finest. Don't make eye contact. They know.
greet.wick.v3.1: Mind the gray. He kicks. I mean that affectionately. Mostly.
npc.dorn.personality: A fisherman who has been waiting for the same fish for eleven years.
chat.dorn.1: A hero's like a fish. Hard to catch, impossible to hold, delicious when you finally do.
chat.dorn.2: That was a joke. Please laugh.
greet.dorn.v0.1: Fishing's still good. Better with the city quiet. Come sit.
greet.dorn.v1.1: I caught it. It was smaller than I remembered. I let it go. It's mine in spirit.
greet.dorn.v2.1: Fishing contest this Founders' Festival! Grand prize: a trophy shaped like a carp. I am a man of simple dreams.
greet.dorn.v3.1: Shh. The big one's close. I can feel it in my knees.
npc.kestrel.personality: Leads Silverwing, a rival adventurer team, and assumes every rank is a race.
chat.kestrel.1: Rank isn't everything. It's just the part they put on the board.
chat.kestrel.2: I'd still like to beat you. For the board.
greet.kestrel.v0.1: Silverwing is training the next generation of A-rankers. Do not tell them you beat us. They're optimistic.
greet.kestrel.v1.1: Fine, you win. For now. We'll ride with you at the Gate. Don't make it weird.
greet.kestrel.v2.1: We found out you're S-rank. Congratulations. We're going to beat your bounty record. Just so you know.
greet.kestrel.v3.1: Silverwing! Rank A, fifty-two bounties, zero failures. And you are? Oh. You. Right.
npc.vane.personality: Silverwing's mage; flashy, sarcastic, secretly obsessed with Lyra's notes.
chat.vane.1: Every mage wants raw power. I want style.
greet.vane.v0.1: I'm teaching a class. She guest-lectured. I fell off my chair.
greet.vane.v1.1: Her east wing! I attended the opening. I may have cried. It was the dust.
greet.vane.v2.1: I heard you picked up Lyra Vesperine. Tell her I'm a huge fan. Don't tell her I said that.
greet.vane.v3.1: Behold! The most dazzling mage in Aurelheim. Don't clap; it distracts the lightning.
npc.greta.personality: A retired adventurer who still sits facing the door.
chat.greta.1: Every adventurer thinks the next dungeon will be the one that makes them rich. It makes someone rich. Rarely the adventurer.
chat.greta.2: Pick a good cook. Pick a good healer. The rest is details.
greet.greta.v0.1: I'll knit your party something warm. It'll be hideous. It'll save your toes.
greet.greta.v1.1: The war's close, I can feel it in my hip. Take my advice: pack socks.
greet.greta.v2.1: You're the new S-rank. I was an A once. We didn't have S-rank then. We had 'lucky'.
greet.greta.v3.1: Sit down, child. Back to the wall, face to the door. Habit. I've outlived three parties and one marriage.
npc.ilse.personality: A young herbalist with dirt under her nails and more patience than the guild board.
chat.ilse.1: Plants are loud once you learn how to listen.
chat.ilse.2: Moonpetal hums. Not a tune. A sort of... agreement.
greet.ilse.v0.1: I started a garden on the north wall. It's mostly weeds. They're lovely weeds.
greet.ilse.v1.1: Selwyn's potions sell like hotcakes. Mine sell like hot, slightly-better-than-hotcakes.
greet.ilse.v2.1: Old Fenn taught me everything. He also taught me how to be quiet. I use the first lesson more.
greet.ilse.v3.1: Fresh moonpetal! Dried frostcap! Ask me about the difference. No, really, ask. No one asks.
npc.alden.personality: A young guard trying very hard to look older than nineteen.
chat.alden.1: Sometimes a guard's job is standing very still while something scary happens.
chat.alden.2: I'm getting good at that part.
greet.alden.v0.1: I get to march with the army. First time outside the walls. Is it big? Everyone says it's big.
greet.alden.v1.1: Captain Dunmore says I've improved. She said it very quietly. I think I'm in trouble.
greet.alden.v2.1: I was at the festival. I saw the light. I was too scared to run. I'm told that's bravery.
greet.alden.v3.1: Halt! Er. Welcome. I mean halt. State your business. Please. Sir.
npc.verrin.personality: A noblewoman who delivers insults as compliments and compliments as threats.
chat.verrin.1: Nobility is a performance for an audience that never leaves.
chat.verrin.2: Heroes at least get to stop for tea.
greet.verrin.v0.1: Darius is doing well. I'd say I'm proud. I'd never tell him. We have an arrangement.
greet.verrin.v1.1: The Archbishop at my table for years! I'm mortified. I'll donate to everything. Twice.
greet.verrin.v2.1: Hanging out with a farmer's grandson is so... daring. I adore it. My mother is scandalized.
greet.verrin.v3.1: How refreshing: a hero with a decent haircut. Do mind the mud on my carpet.
npc.penn.personality: An archivist who lowers his voice for every book and every secret.
chat.penn.1: Every great hero in the archive dies in a footnote.
chat.penn.2: Except one. His page is just a title and a gap.
greet.penn.v0.1: I've reopened the founding records. People can read the whole story. Most of them won't.
greet.penn.v1.1: The Crown's memory is in my shelves now. I pretend not to be afraid.
greet.penn.v2.1: Pages are missing from the founding records. Not torn. Cut. Cleanly. Someone had a steady hand and a good reason.
greet.penn.v3.1: Shh. The Archive sleeps. If you wake it, I'm sending you the bill.
npc.tobin.personality: Garrick's apprentice; eager, soot-streaked, and convinced every blade is a masterpiece.
chat.tobin.1: Garrick tells me to listen to the metal. I hear it clanging. Is that it?
greet.tobin.v0.1: Master Garrick says I may touch the large hammers next year. I'm already wearing gloves.
greet.tobin.v1.1: I forged a nail! A good one! Garrick said it was acceptable! I framed it!
greet.tobin.v2.1: Is it true you broke a sword by looking at it? I want to learn that.
greet.tobin.v3.1: Hi! Garrick says I can only touch the small hammers! I'm very good with the small hammers!
npc.ash.personality: A hooded ex-cultist who flinches at bright lights and bright promises.
chat.ash.1: They told me the world was in pain and we could end it. They never said how many would have to stop first.
chat.ash.2: I'm still deciding if I deserve peace.
greet.ash.v0.1: I'm teaching reading at the orphanage. It's the first thing I've done that nobody asked me to regret.
greet.ash.v1.1: The cult is falling apart. I wish I felt better about it.
greet.ash.v2.1: They say the hollow is merciful. It isn't. It's empty, and that isn't the same.
greet.ash.v3.1: ...Oh. A hero. I'm not looking for trouble. I left. I left. Please don't tell them I was here.
npc.odile.personality: A traveling healer who treats everyone, charges whoever can pay, and sleeps in barns.
chat.odile.1: Healers carry something they don't talk about. We call it 'the weight'.
chat.odile.2: Mirelle carries more than most. Look after her.
greet.odile.v0.1: I'm opening a clinic. It'll have a bed for every pilgrim and a bucket for every opinion.
greet.odile.v1.1: I've healed more soldiers than I can count. Not one of them thanked me. I love that. It means they're alive.
greet.odile.v2.1: A hero! Hold still, you have a bruise the shape of a country.
greet.odile.v3.1: Wounds? Aches? Heartbreak? I cure two out of three. Guess which.
npc.halbrook.personality: A round, cheerful peddler who sells everything and apologizes for nothing.
chat.halbrook.1: A good deal leaves both parties thinking they've won.
chat.halbrook.2: A great deal leaves both parties thinking they've been robbed. That's the sweet spot.
greet.halbrook.v0.1: Look, I've got a mural-print scarf from Khemet! No, you do not need it. Buy it.
greet.halbrook.v1.1: Trade routes are open! Prices drop! My wife says this is bad for business. She's wrong. I love it.
greet.halbrook.v2.1: Everyone wants a piece of the hero business. I sell little carved Kael dolls. They're mostly accurate.
greet.halbrook.v3.1: Buy, sell, haggle! I stock everything but opinions. Those are free.
npc.petra.personality: Sells flowers to soldiers, widows and the occasional hero with a lot to apologize for.
chat.petra.1: Flowers don't fix things. They just say, 'I noticed.'
greet.petra.v0.1: Tilly sends me seeds from the camp. They bloom in odd colors. I'm fond of odd.
greet.petra.v1.1: The war's close. Flowers sell better. I hate that. I sell them anyway.
greet.petra.v2.1: A bouquet for your party? Colors tell the story. Let me guess: blue for loyalty, gold for hope.
greet.petra.v3.1: Flowers! Lilies for apologies, roses for confessions, daisies for everything else!
npc.eldric.personality: A weathered farmer who trusts weather and doesn't trust crystals.
chat.eldric.2: You'd make a decent farmer. You should be one. Hmm. Nope. Hero's fine.
greet.eldric.v0.1: Ashbrook's loud again. Children, geese, bad singing. I'd forgotten I missed it.
greet.eldric.v1.1: We're rebuilding. The wheat will grow back before the walls do. Priorities.
greet.eldric.v2.1: Ashes in the field. I'll replant. I always replant. Don't thank me for it, thank the dirt.
greet.eldric.v3.1: Harvest's late. If that crystal glows, you tell it I said hello. And that my back hurts.
npc.bess.personality: Bakes at dawn, gossips at noon, forgives everything for a good loaf.
chat.bess.1: Bread is just patience in a crust.
chat.bess.2: Your grandfather used to steal the heels. I let him. Every time.
greet.bess.v0.1: Free bread for the hero who saved us. And for anyone who looks hungry. Which is everyone.
greet.bess.v1.1: We have a new oven! It's a little crooked. Like me. Come try it.
greet.bess.v2.1: My ovens are gone. My hands are not. I'll bake over a campfire if I have to.
greet.bess.v3.1: Good morning, dear! Take a roll for the road. A ceremony day without breakfast is a bad omen.
npc.rolf.personality: A nine-year-old convinced he's going to be a hero, a pirate, and a baker.
chat.rolf.1: Everybody says you're strong. Are you ever scared?
chat.rolf.2: (Kael: 'Every day.') Whoa. That's... that's kind of cool actually.
greet.rolf.v0.1: Look, I'm taller! Sort of! Mostly my hair.
greet.rolf.v1.1: I practice with a stick! Tilly says it's a good stick! I named it Kael Jr.!
greet.rolf.v2.1: The bad things came and I hid in the barrel. Tilly says barrels are very brave. I'm gonna be brave next time.
greet.rolf.v3.1: Are you gonna get a sword? A big one? Can I touch it? Can I? Okay, just the handle!
npc.wren.personality: Ashbrook's healer, a sharp-eyed grandmother who has seen every fever twice.
chat.wren.1: A healer's work is mostly sitting with people.
greet.wren.v0.1: Your grandfather was stubborn as a rock and twice as quiet. I miss him. Visit the shrine.
greet.wren.v1.1: The camp's clinic is mine now. Don't let them tell you I'm retired.
greet.wren.v2.1: I stitched half the village after the fire. My needle's tired. I'm not.
greet.wren.v3.1: Stand still, boy. You're all elbows and nerves. Hold out your hand. Hm. Trembling. Healthy trembling.
npc.seren.personality: A calm monk who speaks rarely and hits exactly once.
chat.seren.1: Focus is not squeezing. It is letting go of everything except the one thing.
chat.seren.2: Your grandfather knew. He taught me the pause before the strike.
greet.seren.v0.1: Tea? It is only water. But sit, and listen to it being water.
greet.seren.v0.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'focus strike' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.seren.v1.1: The trees are quieter. That is good. A forest at ease is a forest that forgets to worry.
greet.seren.v1.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'focus strike' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.seren.v2.1: You come to learn focus? I do not teach. I wait until you are ready, and then I hit you.
greet.seren.v2.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'focus strike' and come back with a story to tell.
greet.seren.v3.1: Be still. Listen. The forest is speaking, and you are interrupting.
greet.seren.v3.3: Prove yourself first. Look for the trial that goes with 'focus strike' and come back with a story to tell.
npc.ravi.personality: A tracker who says little and notices everything.
chat.ravi.1: A wolf doesn't hate you. It just wants to eat. That's cleaner than most people.
chat.ravi.2: The 'wolf who wasn't'... I saw it. It looked at me like it was sorry.
greet.ravi.v0.1: A good hunt is just patience in boots.
greet.ravi.v1.1: The wolves are calming. A relief. I almost miss the challenge.
greet.ravi.v2.1: The wolves have changed. Hungrier. Meaner. Not natural.
greet.ravi.v3.1: Quiet. Something's moving in the ferns. Not an animal. Not a person. Something that wants to be both.
npc.moss.personality: A cheerful ranger who names the trees and apologizes to them.
chat.moss.1: I talk to trees because they never interrupt.
chat.moss.2: Except when they do. Then they just fall on you.
greet.moss.v0.1: I planted a sapling in your name. If it dies, it's the soil's fault.
greet.moss.v1.1: The trees are standing taller. I swear I heard one hum.
greet.moss.v2.1: Corruption's creeping from the Rootheart. I patrol the edge. I bring them tea. It doesn't help. It helps me.
greet.moss.v3.1: Hello, Oak! Hello, Pine! Hello, stranger! Please don't kick the roots. They're sensitive.
npc.sahar.personality: An innkeeper who measures guests by how they treat her lemonade.
chat.sahar.1: A guest tells you who they are in the first five minutes. The rest is paperwork.
chat.sahar.2: You said thank you without being asked. Rare.
greet.sahar.v0.1: A room is always ready for you. And a lemonade. Without the sneer.
greet.sahar.v1.1: The roads are open and the beds are full. I'm very tired and very happy.
greet.sahar.v2.1: Everyone talks about you. I prefer to judge by how you handle my lemonade. Hm. Acceptable.
greet.sahar.v3.1: Water is free. Hospitality is not. Lemonade is a reasonable compromise.
npc.jalil.personality: Breeds the finest sand-striders in the Sunscar and refuses to be hurried.
chat.jalil.1: The first rule of the desert: respect the water.
chat.jalil.2: The second rule: respect whoever's holding it.
greet.jalil.v0.1: Come ride at dawn. The desert is a different creature then.
greet.jalil.v1.1: The desert is easier on the riders now. The sand-striders appreciate it. They'd say so if they could.
greet.jalil.v2.1: You earned the tribes' trust. A mount awaits you. Do not insult her by being nervous.
greet.jalil.v3.1: A mount is not a tool. It is a family member with opinions. Mine have strong ones.
npc.fatima.personality: Weaves stories into cloth and charges extra for the moral.
chat.fatima.2: I wove the lone king three times and each time he came out lonelier.
greet.fatima.v0.1: The tapestry's finished. I'm hanging it in the council hall. Come see yourself in thread.
greet.fatima.v1.1: Every cloth I make has a rider in the corner now. A man with a sword and three friends. It looks right.
greet.fatima.v2.1: I'm weaving the story of the sands. The center is empty. A man with a golden aura, alone. I keep unpicking him.
greet.fatima.v3.1: Hold the thread, hero. Gently. It remembers the hands that held it.
npc.idris.personality: A desert scout who walks lightly, speaks softly, and counts everything twice.
chat.idris.1: I can read a caravan's age by the depth of its wheel ruts.
chat.idris.2: I can read a person's lie by how fast they swallow. Don't swallow.
greet.idris.v0.1: The dunes are quiet. Come walk with me. Bring water. And humility.
greet.idris.v1.1: The raiders are gone. I still look over my shoulder. I'll stop eventually.
greet.idris.v2.1: There are tracks near the catacombs. Large. Armored. Not human. I don't like it.
greet.idris.v3.1: Sand tells stories to those who watch it. Today it says: a storm, tomorrow afternoon. Pack accordingly.
npc.nashu.personality: Digs for old stones and talks to them in an old tongue.
chat.nashu.1: History isn't dead. It's just very quiet.
chat.nashu.2: You have to dig for what it said.
greet.nashu.v0.1: The ruins are mine to study forever. I've never been happier.
greet.nashu.v1.1: The Hourglass Vault is open. The sand there is... flowing in the right direction, finally. We're taking measurements.
greet.nashu.v2.1: We found a new chamber! Mostly sand. And one broken pot. Still, the pot is fascinating.
greet.nashu.v3.1: Careful with that brush! It's older than your nation and probably more important.
npc.gudrun.personality: A burly innkeeper who thinks stew solves everything and is usually right.
chat.gudrun.1: In the mountains, you learn two things. Keep your hands warm. Keep your friends warmer.
chat.gudrun.2: Hmm. That one is catchy. Write it down.
greet.gudrun.v0.1: Come back soon. I'll make you stew. It's the only thing I do. I do it well.
greet.gudrun.v1.1: The Choir's silence kept the guests away for weeks. Now I've got more than I can feed. Grand.
greet.gudrun.v2.1: A hero in my inn! Free stew. Don't get used to it.
greet.gudrun.v3.1: Stew's hot, beds are warm, ale's cold. Don't ask me which is which. You'll find out.
npc.halvar.personality: Casts the cathedral's bells and swears they sing different tunes each winter.
chat.halvar.1: Isrevna used to tune the bells herself. They were perfect.
greet.halvar.v0.1: I cast a small bell for your party. Hang it somewhere dignified. It'll hum when you're near.
greet.halvar.v1.1: The bell rings again. A clean note. I didn't know I missed it.
greet.halvar.v2.1: The big bell cracked in the Choir's silence. I'm recasting it. Hard work. Hard sorrow.
greet.halvar.v3.1: Bells aren't bronze. They're memory. Strike one and it tells you who rang it last.
npc.sigrid.personality: A young guide who treats every mountain as a rival and every client as a friend.
chat.sigrid.1: A climber's secret: every summit is just a long way of coming home.
chat.sigrid.2: Or a long way of finding out you shouldn't have left.
greet.sigrid.v0.1: Bring me along when you go back up. I'll carry the rope. And the snacks.
greet.sigrid.v1.1: The mountain's friendlier. Almost chatty. I'll miss the danger, a little.
greet.sigrid.v2.1: Torvik taught me. He also taught me to be afraid of the Lighthouse. I'm planning a trip. Don't tell him.
greet.sigrid.v3.1: Let's climb! Not that one. That one's fussy. This one. This one loves us.
npc.cinda.personality: Brandt's apprentice; fearless around fire, terrified of mistakes.
chat.cinda.1: Forge-songs come from the hammer's rhythm. Each smith has their own.
chat.cinda.2: Mine's a bit off. Brandt says that's character.
greet.cinda.v0.1: I'm teaching others now. I tell them: don't be afraid of the fire. Be afraid of not asking.
greet.cinda.v1.1: Brandt let me do the final polish! My hands shook. The edge held. He didn't say anything. He hugged me. It was awkward.
greet.cinda.v2.1: Making the hero's sword? I'm helping! My job is to hold the thing. The thing is very hot. I'm brave.
greet.cinda.v3.1: Master Brandt says I'm not allowed to hit the forge with a sword. I say it's a test.
npc.magnus.personality: Feeds the city's furnaces with a growl and a surprisingly soft singing voice.
chat.magnus.1: A fire needs three things: fuel, air, and someone who cares.
greet.magnus.v0.1: Furnaces burn clean now. I hum while I shovel. Cinda says it's the first time she's heard me sing.
greet.magnus.v1.1: The eruption didn't hit. We lit candles anyway. Habit.
greet.magnus.v2.1: Volcano's grumbling. I can feel it in my teeth. I don't like it when my teeth have opinions.
greet.magnus.v3.1: Coal's low. Tempers are high. Want to help or want to talk?
npc.vesna.personality: Serves Lava-Fish Special to anyone brave enough and regrets it with a laugh.
chat.vesna.1: I catch the fish myself. It's a spectator sport.
chat.vesna.2: Do not feed it to Magnus. He cries.
greet.vesna.v0.1: A hero can only be as strong as his stomach. Eat, eat.
greet.vesna.v1.1: The fish were running thick this week. I'm swamped and delighted.
greet.vesna.v2.1: A hero! Try the Special! Come on! I'll put it on the house. And on your tongue.
greet.vesna.v3.1: Lava-Fish Special! It bites back! Ask for it mild if you've got a soft tongue.
npc.doro.personality: A grizzled miner who knows every shaft by its smell.
chat.doro.1: A lamp, a pick, and a loud voice. That's all a miner needs.
chat.doro.2: And a friend who'll dig you out.
greet.doro.v0.1: I've started telling the young ones about the song. They say I'm daft. I say they'll hear it.
greet.doro.v1.1: The mines are safe, the song's louder. Beautiful.
greet.doro.v2.1: There's a song in the mines. Low. Like a blacksmith humming. It stops when you look for it.
greet.doro.v3.1: The Ashen Mines go deeper than the maps do. Nobody likes to talk about the bottom.
npc.vale_d.personality: A soldier who ran once and has been trying to forgive himself ever since.
chat.vale_d.1: You're not a coward because you run. You're a coward because you stop trying.
greet.vale_d.v0.1: I've been given a new shield. It's heavier than the old one. I'm learning to carry it.
greet.vale_d.v1.1: I held the line this time. It was terrible. I'd do it again.
greet.vale_d.v2.1: I wrote a letter to my daughter. I never sent it. Will you?
greet.vale_d.v3.1: I ran. I admit it. When the first wave came I dropped my shield and fled. Shoot me or hire me.
npc.reyna.personality: A field medic who sleeps in her boots and counts the living, not the dead.
chat.reyna.1: The enemy doesn't scare me. Running out of bandages does.
chat.reyna.2: If you ever pass through here with spare linen, I will love you forever.
greet.reyna.v0.1: The medic tent's quiet. I'll never get used to that.
greet.reyna.v1.1: We've lost fewer than expected. I keep counting. It still doesn't feel like enough.
greet.reyna.v2.1: Hollow sickness spreads fast. Hold your breath near the gate. I don't know if it helps. It makes me feel useful.
greet.reyna.v3.1: Sit. Show me where it hurts. No, the real spot. Soldiers always lie about the real spot.
cs.awakening.1: Ashbrook at dawn. Frost on the thatch, smoke from a dozen chimneys, and sixteen-year-old {player_name} standing at the shrine steps trying very hard not to look nervous.
cs.awakening.2: The Awakening Ceremony is older than the village. Every child of sixteen places a hand on the crystal. It answers with a color, and a rank. Step forward.
cs.awakening.3: It's just a rock. It's just a rock. It's just a rock.
cs.awakening.4: The crystal wakes. Gold light, brighter than the sunrise, floods the shrine. The glass cracks like ice on a pond and does not stop glowing.
cs.awakening.5: ...S-rank. The first in three hundred years. Ascendant.
cs.awakening.6: The villagers cheer. Then, one by one, they fall quiet. Nobody meets his eyes.
cs.awakening.7: Why is everyone looking at me like that?
cs.awakening.8: Like what? Like you're the best thing that ever happened to this village? Don't be stupid. Come on. Let's go.
cs.awakening.9: She laughs. It sounds a little too bright. For the first time in his life, {player_name} feels alone in a crowd.
cs.skarn_arrives.1: Evening. The sky over Ashbrook turns the color of a bruise.
cs.skarn_arrives.2: So that's where the light came from. A farm village. How delightfully small.
cs.skarn_arrives.3: Don't mind me, little hero. I'm only the scout. The real visitors come after you've been properly... collected.
cs.skarn_arrives.5: Oh, I like him. He thinks he has a say.
cs.village_burns.1: Fire. The mill, the bakery, the roof of the old shrine. The imps are gone, but the flames are not.
cs.village_burns.2: Kael, the bridge! The children are at the bridge!
cs.village_burns.3: I had him. I almost had him. I could have--
cs.village_burns.4: Not bad for a boy. Come find me when you've grown up. I'll still be here. Burning things.
cs.village_burns.5: {player_name} stands in the ashes with his hands shaking. The glow around him has gone dim, as if ashamed.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.1: Listen, boy. This sword was mine before it was yours. Plain iron. It has never failed me and it never asked me to be a hero.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.2: The Seals are failing. A demon king sleeps under the world and a crown keeps him there. The Crown is in pieces. You will find them. And you will not do it alone.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.3: Grandfather, come with us. Please. There's room on the cart.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.4: There's never room for the old on a cart. Go. Take the survivors. I'll keep the road closed behind you.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.5: I'll carry it! I'll carry all of it, I swear!
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.6: Hah. That is exactly the kind of thing a boy says before he learns how heavy it is. ...Go on. I'm proud of you.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.7: The cart rattles down the road. Behind them, a small figure in grey robes stands in front of the burning gate. Light rises from his hands. Then the road goes quiet.
cs.orwyn_sacrifice.8: I'll carry it. I swear on the sword.
cs.darius_mocks.1: Aurelheim's gates, mid-morning. Merchants, guards, adventurers, and a boy covered in road dust holding a plain iron sword.
cs.darius_mocks.2: Look at that, a farm boy. Does the guild let anyone in now? Or did they run out of competent applicants?
cs.darius_mocks.4: Of course you are. Try not to trip over your sword. It'd be embarrassing for both of us.
cs.darius_mocks.6: I don't know. I only just met him.
cs.duel_intro.1: The Rank-Up Arena. Sand, torchlight, a crowd of Aurelheim's finest betting on the new boy.
cs.duel_intro.2: Rank C trial. Kael of Ashbrook against Darius Valecrest. First yield or first fall. No killing, no cheating, no complaining.
cs.duel_intro.3: I'll be gentle. I want you to remember this fight. For the rest of your short career.
cs.festival_disaster.1: The Founders' Festival. Lanterns, music, a river of laughing people, and, beneath the cathedral steps, a circle drawn in ash.
cs.festival_disaster.2: In the name of the Hollow King. Let the light break.
cs.festival_disaster.3: Cultists in violet robes throw back their cowls. The crowd screams. Guards shout. A wave of black fire rolls across the plaza.
cs.festival_disaster.4: Everyone get behind me! I'll... I'll handle it!
cs.festival_disaster.5: He pulls the power up. The crystal's gold floods his arms, his chest, his eyes. It does not stop where he wants it to. Golden light tears across the plaza, throwing guards off their feet, cracking stone.
cs.festival_disaster.7: I can't! It won't stop! I can't--
cs.festival_disaster.8: A hand catches his shoulder. Hanna's. The light gutters. Silence, apart from the crying.
cs.festival_disaster.9: You are an S-rank. You are not a god. And you are not going to carry this alone. Understood?
cs.bram_shield.1: Fort Greywall. The walls are rubble. The ghosts are gone. Only a man sits on the broken steps, a cracked shield across his knees.
cs.bram_shield.2: You killed my old squad. You know that? Forty of them. Not for malice. They just didn't know they'd died.
cs.bram_shield.3: They were asking for you. By name.
cs.bram_shield.5: Bram stares at the shield for a very long moment. Then he stands. The shield is heavy. He holds it anyway.
cs.bram_shield.6: Behind me, kid. I don't know if I deserve to say it. But I'm going to.
cs.lyra_storm.1: The Forbidden Library. Books spin through the air. Arcane lightning crawls along the shelves. In the middle of it, a girl with silver hair and tears on her face.
cs.lyra_storm.2: Stay back! I can't stop it! It just keeps coming out and I can't stop it!
cs.lyra_storm.3: Kid. She's going to take the roof off.
cs.lyra_storm.5: He walks into the storm. The lightning strikes him, and he does not flinch. Gold flares around him, pushing the chaos back.
cs.lyra_storm.6: See? I'm still standing. You can't hurt me.
cs.lyra_storm.7: ...Nobody has ever stood in it before.
cs.lyra_storm.9: Don't hold back or I'll be insulted. Rival.
cs.mirelle_fading.1: The Sanctum of Dawn. Wounded pilgrims fill the aisles. In front of the altar, a priestess kneels, hands glowing.
cs.mirelle_fading.2: One more. Just one more. Light will find a way.
cs.mirelle_fading.3: Sister, your hair. It's... it's white at the roots.
cs.mirelle_fading.4: It's nothing. It's the light. It happens.
cs.mirelle_fading.5: She smiles. Then her knees give way. Kael catches her. She weighs almost nothing.
cs.mirelle_fading.6: That wasn't light. That was you.
cs.mirelle_fading.7: It's the Tithe. It's my duty. Please don't tell anyone.
cs.mirelle_fading.8: Then let me carry some of it. Come with us. We'll find another way.
cs.resonance_born.1: The Convergence Shrine. Four pedestals, four faint circles of light. A mirror at the center, and in the mirror, four people who are not quite themselves.
cs.resonance_born.2: That's me. Standing alone. Always alone.
cs.resonance_born.3: That's me. Sitting alone, letting them die.
cs.resonance_born.4: That's me. Alone in the ruins I made.
cs.resonance_born.6: They reach out. Not to the mirror. To each other. The four lights meet and braid into one.
cs.resonance_born.10: Light will find a way. Together.
cs.vessara_farewell.1: Rootheart Hollow. The thorns wither. The Thornqueen sinks to her knees, vines peeling away from a face that is almost human.
cs.vessara_farewell.2: Thank you. I could not stop myself. Every year the green grew darker and every year I forgot why I was so tired.
cs.vessara_farewell.4: Do not be. You are carrying so much, little light. Listen. He is waiting at the end of the road. And he is tired.
cs.vessara_farewell.6: The one who wears the Crown's shadow. Be kind. He has been alone so long.
cs.vessara_farewell.7: She fades into green light. A single fragment of the Crown remains, pulsing like a heart.
cs.avalanche.1: Whiteout Pass. A crack like thunder. The mountain slides.
cs.avalanche.2: That was me! That was my fire! I thought it was small and it just kept going and I--
cs.avalanche.4: People could have died! You could have died!
cs.avalanche.5: Kid, listen. I made a mistake that cost forty lives. You made one that cost a bruised shoulder and a lost scarf.
cs.avalanche.6: Mistakes are survivable when you have people beside you. That's what I got wrong back then. Nobody beside me.
cs.betrayal.1: Aurelheim Cathedral. Candlelight. A ritual circle in the nave, and in its center, a girl in white.
cs.betrayal.2: Nine hundred years of Tithes, child. Every drop of life you spend, the Church banks. Every drop of life the Church banks goes to the one who never stopped waiting.
cs.betrayal.3: You told me it was a gift.
cs.betrayal.4: It was. For him. Please do be still.
cs.betrayal.5: Archbishop. Your Grace. Step away from her.
cs.betrayal.7: Don't. I'm angry enough already. I followed the ledgers. Valecrest signatures on every page.
cs.betrayal.8: Gold light cracks the ritual circle. Mirelle gasps. The chain of light binding her to the altar shatters.
cs.bram_stand.1: The Molten Keep. Pyrrhax raises a fist of living fire over the party. Lyra is down. Mirelle is down. Kael is on one knee.
cs.bram_stand.2: Behind me, kid. All of you. Behind me.
cs.bram_stand.4: I've been crushed before. I keep getting up. It's a talent.
cs.bram_stand.5: He plants the Bulwark of Oaths. The blow lands. Stone cracks. Armor sparks. Bram does not move.
cs.bram_stand.6: FORTY of them I left. Not one more. Not today. Not ever!
cs.bram_stand.7: The shield blazes with the names engraved in it. Pyrrhax staggers back.
cs.crown_truth.1: Aurelheim Archive. The four fragments rise, spin, and lock into a crown of white light. Memory pours out of it.
cs.crown_truth.2: I was the first. They called me Ascendant. They told me the world's pain had chosen me.
cs.crown_truth.3: I sealed the Demon King. I took his despair into myself so the world could be spared it. My companions died, or left, or lost their nerve.
cs.crown_truth.4: I carried it alone for three hundred years. Slowly I became what I held.
cs.crown_truth.5: That's Vorathis. The Hollow King. He's you.
cs.crown_truth.6: He is what I became. And he is waiting for the next Ascendant to take the weight. Or to end it.
cs.crown_truth.7: So the talent isn't a gift.
cs.crown_truth.8: It's the world dumping its despair onto one person.
cs.crown_truth.9: Then we break the pattern. All of us. Together.
cs.army_gathers.1: The Hollow Gate. A wall of black stone, a sky like a bruise, and the largest army Veyrath has ever raised.
cs.army_gathers.2: Aurelheim Watch, form up! Guild lines, on me!
cs.army_gathers.3: Every adventurer in the capital. Every rank. I swore I'd never sign this many casualty forms.
cs.army_gathers.4: Don't die. I haven't finished beating you.
cs.army_gathers.5: Everyone stood up for us. Even the people we barely knew.
cs.army_gathers.6: That's what a line is, kid. It's the people who stay.
cs.asks_for_help.1: Voidspire's throne. Gravity collapses. The party is flung down. Kael stands alone against a colossus of shadow.
cs.asks_for_help.2: Sixty seconds. Show me the strength of one who needs no one.
cs.asks_for_help.3: I can... I can do this. I can handle it. I always handle it.
cs.asks_for_help.4: A hand slams him to the ground. The glow around him gutters.
cs.asks_for_help.6: Bram. Lyra. Mirelle. I can't do this alone. I need you.
cs.asks_for_help.7: Took you long enough, kid. Behind me.
cs.asks_for_help.8: Don't hold back. I'm right behind you.
cs.asks_for_help.9: Light will find a way. Stand up, Kael. We're here.
cs.quartet_strike.1: Four lights, one rhythm. Bram's vow. Lyra's star. Mirelle's dawn. Kael's blade.
cs.quartet_strike.6: The throne room shatters in gold.
cs.aurel_farewell.1: The void fades. A man kneels where the Hollow King stood: tall, tired, human. Aurel.
cs.aurel_farewell.2: You did not carry it alone. That was the part I never learned.
cs.aurel_farewell.3: We'll carry it. All of it.
cs.aurel_farewell.4: Then it was not wasted. Thank you. All of you.
cs.aurel_farewell.5: The Sealing Crown shatters into light. The cycle ends. Aurel's spirit passes on, smiling.
cs.ending_montage.1: Aurelheim, a week later. The party returns to cheering streets. Hanna reads out the heroes' names. Pip faints.
cs.ending_montage.2: Ashbrook is rebuilt, board by board. A small shrine stands where the old one burned. Orwyn's spirit watches the sunrise from its steps.
cs.post_credits.1: A small village. A child steps up to the shrine. The crystal flares. This time it glows green.
q.MQ01.title: The Day of the Crystal
q.MQ01.sum: Every sixteen-year-old in Veyrath faces the Awakening Ceremony. Help Tilly with the morning chores, then climb the shrine steps.
q.MQ01.o0: Help Tilly with the morning chores
q.MQ01.o1: Attend the Awakening Ceremony at the shrine
scene.mq01.tilly.1: There you are! You're late for chores and the ceremony's in an hour. Here, grab a bucket. Move, strike, dodge the goose. Standard stuff.
scene.mq01.tilly.2: Left stick to walk, camera with the mouse. Try not to run into the well. It's got feelings.
scene.mq01.tilly.3: Good. Now the goose. Hit it with the broom. Gently. It's an old goose.
scene.mq01.tilly.5: That's normal. Dodge! Tap the roll button. Nice! See? You're a natural.
scene.mq01.tilly.6: Okay. Chores done. Go on, the shrine's waiting. I'll be right behind you. I'm just going to stand somewhere safe.
scene.mq01.haldor.1: Ah, {player_name}. You're here. Good. Stand there. No, there. Hands behind your back until I say.
scene.mq01.haldor.2: Every child of Veyrath places a hand on the crystal on their sixteenth year. It answers with a rank. Most are D. A few are B. Nobody is S.
q.MQ02.title: Smoke on the Horizon
q.MQ02.sum: A demon scout has followed the golden light to Ashbrook. Protect the village.
q.MQ02.o1: Reach the outskirts and face the demon scout
q.MQ03.title: Ashes and Oaths
q.MQ03.sum: Orwyn presses his sword into your hands and tells you the truth about the Seals.
q.MQ03.o0: Find Elder Orwyn at the shrine
scene.mq03.orwyn.1: Kael. Here. Take Dawnbrand. It was mine, and my teacher's before that. Plain iron. It has never asked anyone to be a hero.
scene.mq03.orwyn.3: Listen carefully. I won't have time to repeat it. Three hundred years ago a man named Aurel sealed the Demon King with a crown. The Crown broke into four Seals. They are failing.
scene.mq03.orwyn.4: The demons woke early because of you. Not your fault. A light that bright can be seen from the other side of the world.
scene.mq03.orwyn.5: (Something crashes outside. The scout is coming.)
q.MQ04.title: The Road to Aurelheim
q.MQ04.sum: Lead the refugees through bandit country to the guild capital.
q.MQ05.title: Registered at Last
q.MQ05.sum: Register at the Adventurer Guild and learn how the quest board, bounty system and shops work.
q.MQ05.o0: Fill in the registration form with Pip
MQ05.offer.1: Name: {player_name}. Origin: a village that doesn't exist anymore. Talent: gold. Ah. Yes. I read the festival reports.
MQ05.offer.2: I'm registering you as F-rank. Publicly. The S-rank stays sealed in my desk until you've earned the weight of it. For your own safety.
MQ05.offer.3: Go through the motions. Pip will stamp your card. Garrick will measure your hands. Selwyn will try to sell you something. Come back when you've met them all.
MQ05.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
MQ05.done.1: Card, ring, quest board, bounty list. You're a real adventurer now. Congratulations.
MQ05.done.2: One piece of advice. Strong heroes die alone. Remember that.
MQ05.done.3: I've seen too many gold-glowing prodigies in my time. None of them finished the story.
q.MQ06.title: Trial of the Proud
q.MQ06.sum: The Rank-Up Tournament: beat Darius Valecrest in a duel to reach C-rank.
q.MQ06.o0: Defeat Darius Valecrest in the arena
MQ06.offer.1: Rank-ups at Aurelheim are settled in the arena. You want C-rank? Beat a C-rank. I've arranged a sparring partner.
MQ06.offer.2: Darius Valecrest. Noble family, A-rank prodigy, mouth like a rusty hinge. He asked for you by name.
MQ06.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
q.MQ07.title: The Goblin Warrens
q.MQ07.sum: A goblin nest is strangling the trade routes. Clear it, and find out why they're so organized.
MQ07.offer.1: Goblins have taken the south road. Caravans are paying tolls in blood. B-rank bounty, and it's yours if you want it.
MQ07.offer.2: Take a party. I know you're alone. Take a party anyway.
MQ07.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
MQ07.done.1: A demon mark on a goblin. Not the first. Not the last. The report is going straight to my desk.
MQ07.done.2: B-rank. Well earned. Don't let it go to your head.
q.MQ08.title: The Hollow Mark
q.MQ08.sum: The demon mark leads back to Skarn. Learn what the Seals are, then hunt the scout down.
q.MQ08.o0: Consult Archivist Penn about the Seals
MQ08.offer.1: Sit down. This is not for the board. Three hundred years ago the hero Aurel sealed the Demon King with a crown. It shattered into four Seals: Life, Time, Spirit, Flame.
MQ08.offer.2: The Seals are weakening. The Demon King's heirs are waking. The mark you found on that goblin is theirs.
MQ08.offer.3: There's a scout. Skarn. He burned your village. Penn has the old records. After that, find him.
MQ08.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
q.MQ09.title: Crown of Crisis
q.MQ09.sum: A demon cult attacks Aurelheim during the Founders' Festival. Stop them and keep your power in check.
q.MQ09.o0: Defeat the cultists in the plaza
q.MQ09.o1: Regain control of the Ascendant power
MQ09.done.1: Gather round. Everyone. By the authority of the Adventurer Guild, I hereby announce the first S-rank in three hundred years.
MQ09.done.2: {player_name} of Ashbrook. Ascendant. You will retrieve the four Seal Fragments of the Crown. And you will do it with a party.
MQ09.done.4: That wasn't a request. Strong heroes die alone. Pick three friends. Start with the ones who aren't afraid of you.
MQ09.progress.1: Not done yet? Take your time.
scene.mq09.calm.1: Breathe. The light is going down. Good. Count to ten. You're all right.
q.MQ10.title: Into the Whisperwood
q.MQ10.sum: The first Seal Fragment, Life, lies somewhere in the Whisperwood. The trees whisper your name.
MQ10.offer.1: The Seal of Life is in Rootheart Hollow, in the heart of the Whisperwood. The forest is sick. Corruption is spreading from the Hollow.
MQ10.offer.2: There's a hermit named Fenn. He talks to plants. He'll know the way. Be polite to the moss.
MQ10.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
MQ10.done.1: Hmm. The trees say your name differently than the others. They say it like it's a question.
MQ10.done.2: A knight's tracks lead to Greywall. Follow them. He'll be the one drinking.
q.MQ11.title: The Knight Who Dropped His Shield
q.MQ11.sum: A wounded knight's trail leads to the ruins of Fort Greywall. Help him face his old squad.
q.MQ11.o1: Lay the undead Greywall soldiers to rest
q.MQ11.o2: Convince Bram to take up his shield
scene.mq11.bram.1: Go away. I'm not for hire. I told you.
scene.mq11.bram.2: The ghosts at the gate were asking for you.
scene.mq11.bram.4: They asked if you got out.
scene.mq11.bram.5: I got out. That's the problem.
scene.mq11.bram.c5_0: Then come out again. With us.
scene.mq11.bram.7: ...Fine. But I'm not doing it for a medal. Behind me, kid.
scene.mq11.bram.10: Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
q.MQ12.title: The Girl in the Forbidden Library
q.MQ12.sum: A prodigy's mana is awakening a library guardian. Survive her storm and calm her.
MQ12.offer.1: I would prefer you not know I asked. The Forbidden Library has woken up. Lyra Vesperine, a former student, hides there. Her mana is... unstable.
MQ12.offer.2: The guardian responds to her fear. I cannot reach her. I have, shall we say, a history. You are strong enough to stand in it.
MQ12.offer.3: Please. She is not a danger. She believes she is.
MQ12.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
scene.mq12.lyra.1: Stay back! I can't stop it! The shelves, the lightning, it just keeps coming!
scene.mq12.lyra.3: You should be! I took out a wing of the Academy at fifteen!
scene.mq12.lyra.4: Then it's about time somebody stood in it.
scene.mq12.lyra.6: ...You're the one with more raw power than me, aren't you? Fine. Don't hold back or I'll be insulted.
scene.mq12.lyra.9: I need a minute. Go away. Come back in an hour. I'll be less explosive.
q.MQ13.title: The Priestess's Secret
q.MQ13.sum: Cult-corrupted monsters attack the Sanctum of Dawn. A priestess heals the wounded and pays a price she hides.
q.MQ13.o2: Convince Sister Mirelle to travel with you
scene.mq13.mirelle.1: Blessings of the dawn, traveler. The wounded come first, then questions. Please. Anyone who can hold a bandage.
scene.mq13.mirelle.2: Sister, your hair is turning white.
scene.mq13.mirelle.3: It's the light. It's nothing. Please, the next patient.
scene.mq13.mirelle.4: That wasn't light. That was you.
scene.mq13.mirelle.c4_0: Come with us. We'll find another way.
scene.mq13.mirelle.6: ...Light will find a way. Yes. I'll come. I don't know why I'm saying yes.
scene.mq13.mirelle.9: Thank you. Hold this one steady.
q.MQ14.title: Four Hearts, One Blade
q.MQ14.sum: At the Convergence Shrine, the party faces mirrors of its fears and learns to share a single light.
q.MQ15.title: The Thornqueen Falls
q.MQ15.sum: Fight Vessara in Rootheart Hollow to claim the Seal of Life.
q.MQ16.title: Into the Sunscar
q.MQ16.sum: Cross the desert, win the oasis tribes' trust, and learn of the Hourglass Vault.
q.MQ16.o0: Cross the desert to Qasr Amun
MQ16.done.1: You have walked our sands and kept your temper. That is more than most kings. The hourglass is in the Vault. The tribes will guide you.
MQ16.done.2: And you may take a mount. Be nice to her. She bites people who are not.
MQ16.progress.1: Not done yet? Take your time.
q.MQ17.title: The Hourglass Tyrant
q.MQ17.sum: Fight Khemet-Ur, who can rewind time to undo damage and wounds.
q.MQ18.title: The Frostspire Ascent
q.MQ18.sum: Climb through the whiteout. An avalanche tests the party's trust.
scene.mq18.torvik.1: Whiteout Pass in this weather? You're braver than the guides. Or dumber. I haven't decided.
scene.mq18.torvik.2: Stay on the rope. Don't shout. Don't cast anything bigger than a candle. The mountain listens.
scene.mq18.torvik.4: (They begin the climb. A low rumble rolls down the slope...)
q.MQ19.title: The Winter Choir
q.MQ19.sum: Fight Isrevna in the Silent Choir Cathedral, where spells fall silent.
q.MQ19.o1: Pass through the husks of the choir
q.MQ20.title: Betrayal at Aurelheim
q.MQ20.sum: Return to the capital and stop Archbishop Caldrin before he completes the ritual.
q.MQ20.o0: Enter the Cathedral of the Dawn
q.MQ20.o2: Break the Vital Tithe with the Ascendant light
q.MQ21.title: Descent into Cinderhold
q.MQ21.sum: The blacksmith guilds forge the party's final weapons while a volcano threatens the city.
q.MQ21.o3: Bring Brandt four Ember Steel Ingots
MQ21.done.1: Four ingots of the best ember steel in the Keep, and not one scorched finger. I like you. Hold still.
MQ21.done.2: The Bulwark of Oaths for the shield-bearer, Starcaller for the witch, the Dawnsong for the priestess. Yours I'm saving for after the Warden.
MQ21.done.3: Don't die before I can finish it.
MQ21.progress.1: Not done yet? Take your time.
q.MQ22.title: The Molten Warden
q.MQ22.sum: Fight Pyrrhax in the Molten Keep. He punishes anyone who does not guard.
q.MQ23.title: The Truth of the Crown
q.MQ23.sum: Reassemble the Sealing Crown and see what it remembers.
q.MQ23.o4: Let the Crown remember at the Convergence Shrine
q.MQ24.title: Siege of the Hollow Gate
q.MQ24.sum: The Guild, the Church, Darius and everyone you helped march on the Hollow Gate. Break through while the army holds the line.
q.MQ24.o0: Join the army at the front camp
q.MQ24.o1: Break the legion at the gate
q.MQ24.o2: Defeat Skarn, Herald of the Hollow King
q.MQ25.title: The Hollow King
q.MQ25.sum: Enter the Voidspire and face Vorathis. The Solo Ascent ends here.
q.MQ25.o0: Climb to the throne of Voidspire
cs.cq-bram1_intro.1: The memorial. I haven't been back. Forty names, and I don't remember how to spell half of them.
cs.cq-bram1_intro.2: We'll find them. We'll write them down.
cs.cq-bram1_intro.3: ...Aye. Behind me, kid. It's thick with ghosts.
cs.cq-bram1_outro.1: Thank you. That's... forty names. I read them aloud. Every one. They sounded like people, instead of shapes.
cs.cq-bram1_outro.2: (Bram's shield now bears a line of small engraved names.)
cs.cq-bram1_outro.3: I'll carry them. For good this time.
q.CQ-Bram1.title: Names on the Wall
q.CQ-Bram1.sum: Visit Greywall's memorial and recover the names of Bram's fallen squad.
q.CQ-Bram1.o1: Clear the restless spirits from the memorial
cs.cq-bram2_intro.1: One of the letters in Greywall's ledger was never sent. Corporal Hale. His daughter lives in Aurelheim. Herbalist, I'm told.
cs.cq-bram2_intro.2: Do you want me to deliver it?
cs.cq-bram2_intro.3: No. I want to hand it over myself. I just don't know if my legs will go.
cs.cq-bram2_outro.1: He wrote that he was proud of me. That he wasn't afraid. That he wished the captain wouldn't blame himself.
cs.cq-bram2_outro.3: Then let me tell you what a daughter's allowed to say. I forgive you. Please stop.
q.CQ-Bram2.title: The Last Letter
q.CQ-Bram2.sum: Deliver a fallen soldier's last letter to the family he left behind.
q.CQ-Bram2.o0: Deliver the letter to Ilse in Aurelheim
cs.cq-bram3_intro.1: Raiders have the Shield Guard's banner. They hung it over a campfire. I can't let that stand.
cs.cq-bram3_intro.2: And then you'll finally face Dunmore.
cs.cq-bram3_intro.3: She was my commanding officer. She wrote the report that blamed me. I've been afraid of that report for years.
cs.cq-bram3_outro.1: Captain Ironvale. That banner is the one I swore on. I wrote that report in anger. I should have burned it.
cs.cq-bram3_outro.3: No. You deserved a better commander. Welcome back to the Guard. If you'll have us.
q.CQ-Bram3.title: The Captain's Return
q.CQ-Bram3.sum: Reclaim the stolen Royal Shield Guard banner and face the officer who blamed him.
q.CQ-Bram3.o0: Track the raiders who looted Greywall
q.CQ-Bram3.o1: Defeat the raiders and take back the banner
q.CQ-Bram3.o2: Present the banner to Captain Dunmore
cs.cq-bram4_intro.1: Refugees on the south road. A couple hundred. Imps are going to hit them in an hour. I won't let this one slip.
cs.cq-bram4_intro.3: Behind me, kid. All of you. We hold, and we hold, and we don't stop until the last cart is through.
cs.cq-bram4_outro.1: Last cart's through. No one left behind. Nobody.
cs.cq-bram4_outro.2: (Bram plants his shield and, for the first time, smiles.)
cs.cq-bram4_outro.3: That's what the vow was for. Not to carry the dead. To protect the living. I get it now.
q.CQ-Bram4.title: Hold the Line
q.CQ-Bram4.sum: Defend Emberforge's refugees in a wave defense while the party buys time.
q.CQ-Bram4.o0: Take up position at Emberforge's south gate
cs.cq-lyra1_intro.1: My notes. Four years of research, and I torched them with the east wing. I want them back.
cs.cq-lyra1_intro.3: The cultists from the festival had pages. Hunt them down. Don't read them. They're embarrassing.
cs.cq-lyra1_outro.1: Five pages. Four years. I thought it would hurt to read them.
cs.cq-lyra1_outro.2: It doesn't. They're just... a girl, trying very hard.
cs.cq-lyra1_outro.4: Don't flatter me. I'll start believing you.
q.CQ-Lyra1.title: Ink and Ashes
q.CQ-Lyra1.sum: Recover Lyra's burnt research notes from the Academy ruins.
q.CQ-Lyra1.o1: Gather five charred pages of Lyra's research
cs.cq-lyra2_intro.1: I'm going to talk to Voss. If I go alone I'll start a fire. If you come, I'll start a speech.
cs.cq-lyra2_outro.1: I exiled you because I was afraid of what you might become. I was wrong. The only danger in that wing was my reluctance to ask for help.
cs.cq-lyra2_outro.2: That's the most words you've ever said to me.
q.CQ-Lyra2.title: The Academy's Apology
q.CQ-Lyra2.sum: Confront Dean Voss about Lyra's exile.
cs.cq-lyra3_intro.1: Everyone says control means gripping harder. I think they're wrong. I think control is letting go and trusting someone to catch it.
cs.cq-lyra3_intro.3: I know. That's why I'm trying.
cs.cq-lyra3_outro.1: I didn't clamp down. I opened up. The storm just... sat in my hands, like a cat.
cs.cq-lyra3_outro.3: A very polite cat. Don't hold back or I'll be insulted. I'm not holding back either.
q.CQ-Lyra3.title: Control Is Not Fear
q.CQ-Lyra3.sum: A meditation and duel challenge in a mana storm at the Singing Ice.
q.CQ-Lyra3.o1: Hold your focus against the storm-wraiths
cs.cq-lyra4_intro.1: I want to make a spell. Not copy one. My own. I need you to hold the other end of the rope.
cs.cq-lyra4_intro.2: I thought that was Bram's job.
cs.cq-lyra4_intro.3: I'm the rope. You're the knot.
cs.cq-lyra4_outro.1: Stars, falling. Not as a weapon. As a... conversation.
cs.cq-lyra4_outro.3: Starfall. Yes. Hold on, I'm going to cry a little. Don't look.
q.CQ-Lyra4.title: The Spell Without a Name
q.CQ-Lyra4.sum: Help Lyra create her own signature spell.
q.CQ-Lyra4.o0: Meet Lyra at the Convergence Shrine
q.CQ-Lyra4.o1: Gather two Spirit Shards to anchor the spell
cs.cq-mirelle1_intro.1: I'd like to see the ledgers. Not for you. For me. I think I've been told something that isn't quite the truth.
cs.cq-mirelle1_outro.1: ...Every Tithe. Every priest and priestess for nine centuries. A column of names, and next to it, a number. Years. They subtracted our years.
cs.cq-mirelle1_outro.3: It's worse. They called it love.
q.CQ-Mirelle1.title: Cost of the Light
q.CQ-Mirelle1.sum: Investigate the records of the Vital Tithe.
q.CQ-Mirelle1.o0: Ask Archivist Penn for the Tithe ledgers
q.CQ-Mirelle1.o1: Read the Church's records in the Archive
cs.cq-mirelle2_intro.1: Years ago I healed a fever in a village near the coast. They survived. I never learned their names. I'd like to meet someone.
cs.cq-mirelle2_intro.2: Granny Wren says she knows a grandmother from there.
cs.cq-mirelle2_outro.1: You healed my sister's boy. He grew up. He has children. They're named after the dawn.
