cs.cq-mirelle2_outro.3: That is what you gave. Don't forget the part that's yours.
q.CQ-Mirelle2.title: The Village She Healed
q.CQ-Mirelle2.sum: Revisit a village that was healed by Mirelle years ago.
q.CQ-Mirelle2.o1: Meet Granny Wren, who remembers her
cs.cq-mirelle3_intro.1: Mirelle has never taken a day off. We are going to fix that.
cs.cq-mirelle3_intro.2: I... I'm not sure I know how.
cs.cq-mirelle3_outro.1: Three pastries. A flower I'll never let wilt. A song about a girl who learned to laugh. Is this what living feels like?
cs.cq-mirelle3_outro.3: Light will find a way. And so, it seems, will pastries.
q.CQ-Mirelle3.title: A Day Off
q.CQ-Mirelle3.sum: Take Mirelle to the festival so she can live as herself for a day.
cs.cq-mirelle4_intro.1: For the first time, I'm going to cast it knowing it won't cost me a year. Hold my hand. In case I faint from joy.
cs.cq-mirelle4_outro.1: It's warm. It's mine. It doesn't take anything. Radiant Renewal. That's what I'm calling it.
cs.cq-mirelle4_outro.2: Sister Mirelle. You are teaching us all how to do this.
cs.cq-mirelle4_outro.3: Gladly. Light will find a way. It just took us a long time to look.
q.CQ-Mirelle4.title: Dawn Without Debt
q.CQ-Mirelle4.sum: After the Tithe is broken, Mirelle learns pure holy magic.
q.CQ-Mirelle4.o0: Return to the Sanctum of Dawn
scene.cq_mirelle4.pure.1: Sister Mirelle. Kneel. No: don't kneel. Stand. Teachers don't kneel to students and you stopped being a student today.
scene.cq_mirelle4.pure.2: (Light gathers around Mirelle, gentle and gold.)
q.CQ-Darius1.title: Rivalry Duels
q.CQ-Darius1.sum: Darius wants a rematch. Not for revenge. For accuracy.
q.CQ-Darius1.o0: Out-fight Darius against the shadow soldiers
CQ-Darius1.offer.1: I've been thinking about our duel. The ending, specifically. I'd like to correct it.
CQ-Darius1.offer.2: Count the shadows. First to eight wins. I'll let you start. No. I won't. Start!
CQ-Darius1.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
CQ-Darius1.done.1: Eight to seven. For you. By one stroke. I counted twice. Fine. Fine!
CQ-Darius1.done.2: I'm not bitter. I'm... improving. Don't look at me.
q.CQ-Darius2.title: A Family Secret
q.CQ-Darius2.sum: Darius finds Valecrest signatures in a ledger he was never meant to read.
q.CQ-Darius2.o0: Ask Lady Verrin about the Valecrest ledgers
q.CQ-Darius2.o1: Search the Archive for the ledger
CQ-Darius2.offer.1: I found a name in my father's study. Caldrin. Next to a payment I can't explain. I'd like a witness when I look into it.
CQ-Darius2.offer.2: Not a friend. A witness. There's a difference. Come along.
CQ-Darius2.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
CQ-Darius2.done.1: Valecrest money funded the Tithe. My father knew. My grandfather knew.
CQ-Darius2.done.2: I'm not going to cry. I'm going to... quietly stop speaking to a few people. For a decade. Thank you.
q.CQ-Darius3.title: Redemption Mission
q.CQ-Darius3.sum: Darius asks to join the assault on Caldrin's cult and set the family name right.
q.CQ-Darius3.o0: Ride with Darius to the cathedral
q.CQ-Darius3.o1: Break the cultists guarding the nave
CQ-Darius3.offer.1: The Archbishop's cell is empty. Somebody let him leave. His men are still in the nave. I'm going. I'd like you beside me.
CQ-Darius3.offer.2: Not behind. Beside. It's a new feeling. Don't wreck it.
CQ-Darius3.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
CQ-Darius3.done.1: It's done. The nave's quiet. The Valecrest name is, I think, a little less heavy.
CQ-Darius3.done.2: If you need a sword at the Gate, you'll have mine. Second place is still a place on the line.
q.SQ-Lamb.title: The Missing Lamb
q.SQ-Lamb.sum: Farmer Eldric's youngest lamb has wandered off again. Find it before the wolves do.
q.SQ-Lamb.o1: Chase off the wolves circling the meadow
SQ-Lamb.offer.1: The little one's gone again. Last time she was in the well. Before that, the chimney. Please? My knees can't do meadows.
SQ-Lamb.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Lamb.done.1: She's fine! She's eaten half a pie. Don't ask. Take some bread.
q.SQ-Ledger.title: Pip's Lost Ledger
q.SQ-Ledger.sum: Pip misplaced the guild's rank-up ledger, and Hanna doesn't know. Recover it quietly.
q.SQ-Ledger.o0: Track down the bandits who swiped the ledger
SQ-Ledger.offer.1: Okay, so, I had a ledger. Big, leather, important. Contained every rank-up in the Guild. And I may have lost it. In the city. To bandits. Don't tell Hanna.
SQ-Ledger.offer.2: They went toward the Whisperwood edge. If you could just... retrieve it. Quietly. Very quietly.
SQ-Ledger.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Ledger.done.1: My ledger! Oh, my ledger! You're a saint. A short-tempered saint. Please, never mention this.
q.SQ-Rivals.title: The Rival Adventurers
q.SQ-Rivals.sum: Silverwing's captain bets you can't clear shadow soldiers faster than her team.
q.SQ-Rivals.o0: Out-hunt Silverwing against the shadow soldiers
SQ-Rivals.offer.1: Silverwing: fifty-two bounties, no failures. You: a ceremony and a fire. Let's see who clears six shadows first.
SQ-Rivals.offer.2: Don't take it personally. I just want to be better. It's a sickness.
SQ-Rivals.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Rivals.done.1: Six. Done. Hm. We took seven. Fine. You win this one. I'll buy you a drink. And then I'll start practicing.
q.SQ-RareOre.title: Garrick's Rare Ore
q.SQ-RareOre.sum: Garrick is out of iron ore and too proud to say so.
SQ-RareOre.offer.1: I'm not out of iron. I'm... between orders of iron. If an adventurer happened to have ten pieces on them, it'd be a favor.
SQ-RareOre.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-RareOre.done.1: Ten. Good grain. You've done this before. Take the Oath Knot. It was my father's. Don't tell Tobin.
q.SQ-MiraWish.title: Little Mira's Wish
q.SQ-MiraWish.sum: Mira wants a bouquet of meadow herbs for the stars to smell.
q.SQ-MiraWish.o0: Collect three bundles of meadow herb
q.SQ-MiraWish.o1: Ask Petra to tie them into a bouquet
SQ-MiraWish.offer.1: If I give the stars flowers, they'll look after you. Please? I made a list. It says: flowers. That's the whole list.
SQ-MiraWish.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-MiraWish.done.1: The stars are going to love them. And you. And me. Everyone is going to be so happy.
q.SQ-Bread.title: Bess's Morning Rush
q.SQ-Bread.sum: Bess's ovens are rebuilt, but the flour sacks never arrived.
q.SQ-Bread.o0: Find six sacks of wild flour
SQ-Bread.offer.1: The merchants swear they sent flour. Somebody ate it. Probably the geese. Could you find six sacks? Anywhere. I'm not picky.
SQ-Bread.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Bread.done.1: Six! Bless you, dear. The oven will sing. Take bread. Take all the bread.
q.SQ-Soup.title: Marta's Soup Stock
q.SQ-Soup.sum: The Gilded Lantern's famous soup needs river fish and a handful of herbs.
SQ-Soup.offer.1: The soup is a legend. It's also running out. If you bring fish and herbs, I'll keep a bowl for you until the end of time.
SQ-Soup.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Soup.done.1: Perfect. Smell that. That's the smell of eight generations of stubbornness.
q.SQ-Foal.title: Wick's Runaway Foal
q.SQ-Foal.sum: A horse foal bolted from Wick's stables, and the bandits on the road aren't friendly.
q.SQ-Foal.o0: Drive off the bandits near the road
q.SQ-Foal.o1: Find the foal in the meadow
SQ-Foal.offer.1: Little Star's gone. Bit through the rope and ran. If bandits get her... I'll never forgive myself. Please.
SQ-Foal.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Foal.done.1: There she is. Covered in burrs and proud as a queen. You're a good egg. Take her anklet. It's lucky.
q.SQ-TobinSword.title: Tobin's First Sword
q.SQ-TobinSword.sum: Garrick lets Tobin forge his first sword, if he can find the materials.
SQ-TobinSword.offer.1: It's my first real sword! Master says I can do it if I bring my own ore and coal. I only have enough savings for... zero ore. Can you help?
SQ-TobinSword.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-TobinSword.done.1: It's crooked. It's wonderful. I'm never going to stop looking at it. Here, take this dagger I made last week. It's... also crooked.
q.SQ-VollDrill.title: Sergeant Voll's Drill
q.SQ-VollDrill.sum: Voll orders six shadow soldiers cleared to prove your footwork.
q.SQ-VollDrill.o0: Defeat six shadow soldiers without breaking stride
SQ-VollDrill.offer.1: Footwork is a disgrace. Six shadow soldiers. No retreating, no dithering. Elbows in, chin up. Go!
SQ-VollDrill.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-VollDrill.done.1: Better. Not good. Better. Take the Rising Slash. It's footwork with a spin on it. Don't tell the others it's easy.
q.SQ-Remedy.title: The Hermit's Remedy
q.SQ-Remedy.sum: Old Fenn needs ingredients for a tonic against the creeping corruption.
SQ-Remedy.offer.1: The moss tells me the sickness is spreading from the Hollow. I can brew a tonic. If I had moonpetal. Which I do not, because they don't like me anymore.
SQ-Remedy.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Remedy.done.1: Mm. The moonpetal is pleased. So am I. This will hold the corruption at bay a few days.
q.SQ-Bark.title: Whispers in the Bark
q.SQ-Bark.sum: Ranger Moss hears the trees whispering a name. Find out whose.
SQ-Bark.offer.1: The oldest tree has been whispering a name for a week. I can almost hear it. If you stand there and don't talk, maybe we'll both hear it.
SQ-Bark.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Bark.done.1: It says 'Vessara.' And then 'sorry.' Trees apologize a lot, it turns out.
q.SQ-MoonHarvest.title: Moonpetal Harvest
q.SQ-MoonHarvest.sum: Ilse is behind on her moonpetal harvest and the moon is waxing.
SQ-MoonHarvest.offer.1: Moonpetal only blooms three nights a month. This is one of them. If you pick eight, I'll make you a potion that smells like clean laundry.
SQ-MoonHarvest.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-MoonHarvest.done.1: Eight perfect petals. You don't pull. You ask. Where did you learn that?
q.SQ-Wolf.title: The Wolf Who Wasn't
q.SQ-Wolf.sum: A strange wolf shadows travelers. Ravi thinks it's not what it seems.
SQ-Wolf.offer.1: There's a wolf that doesn't hunt. It follows. It looks at people like it's trying to remember something. I want to know why.
SQ-Wolf.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Wolf.done.1: It was a man once. A traveler. The corruption took the rest. I buried what I could. He seemed to stop... looking.
q.SQ-Monk.title: The Monk's Trial
q.SQ-Monk.sum: Monk Seren will teach Focus Strike to anyone who can hold still while forest spirits test them.
SQ-Monk.offer.1: I do not teach. I wait. If you stand in my clearing and let six rootlings strike at you, and do not strike back until you see the pause... I will teach you.
SQ-Monk.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Monk.done.1: You saw the pause. Good. The strike lives inside it. Now go. Return when you can be quieter.
q.SQ-LostPages.title: Lost Pages of the Whisperwood
q.SQ-LostPages.sum: Penn needs five scattered pages of a mage's grimoire.
SQ-LostPages.offer.1: A grimoire was scattered across the Whisperwood. Five pages. They glow faintly. If you gather them I'll let you borrow the tome. Gently. It bites.
SQ-LostPages.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-LostPages.done.1: Five pages. The ink is humming. This is... Meteor. I'm not allowed to give it to you. I'll look away. Take it.
q.SQ-RootScout.title: Rootheart Reconnaissance
q.SQ-RootScout.sum: Moss wants the thorn minions thinned before the Thornqueen's army grows.
SQ-RootScout.offer.1: The thorns around the Hollow are moving. I don't like it when plants hold grudges. Six minions. Please.
SQ-RootScout.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-RootScout.done.1: Six down. They were more scared than I expected. That's a bad sign.
q.SQ-Glade.title: The Quiet Glade
q.SQ-Glade.sum: A forgotten glade hums a dryad lullaby. Fenn wants someone to hear it.
SQ-Glade.offer.1: There's a glade where the moonpetals grow in a circle. Sit in the middle. Don't speak. If you hear a song, let it finish.
SQ-Glade.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Glade.done.1: You heard it? The one about the first light? ...Of course you did. So did I. So did she. Hush.
q.SQ-FennTea.title: Honey for the Hermit
q.SQ-FennTea.sum: Fenn is out of tea and honey and is getting cranky.
SQ-FennTea.offer.1: Tea. Bread. Moonpetal. I'm not fussy. I only ask that they exist.
SQ-FennTea.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-FennTea.done.1: Hm. Mm. This is acceptable. Tell the moss it was your idea.
q.SQ-RaviHunt.title: Ravi's Hunt
q.SQ-RaviHunt.sum: The wolf packs have multiplied. Ravi can't thin them alone.
SQ-RaviHunt.offer.1: Six wolves. Nothing fancy. I'll take the left ridge. You take the right. We'll meet at the creek.
SQ-RaviHunt.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-RaviHunt.done.1: Quiet work. Nobody died. That's a good hunt.
q.SQ-Thieves.title: The Caravan Thieves
q.SQ-Thieves.sum: Raiders have been ambushing Mayor Edda's caravans on the Caravan Road.
q.SQ-Thieves.o0: Defeat the raiders on the Caravan Road
SQ-Thieves.offer.1: Trade is the oasis's blood. Someone is cutting the vein. I need the raiders stopped. Quietly, preferably. Loudly, if necessary.
SQ-Thieves.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Thieves.done.1: The council thanks you. In writing. I'll have it drafted.
q.SQ-Serpent.title: Sand Serpent Hunt
q.SQ-Serpent.sum: Sand serpents have driven off the scouts of Qasr Amun.
SQ-Serpent.offer.1: Serpents don't hunt this far north. Something pushed them. I'd like four of them gone before something else does.
SQ-Serpent.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Serpent.done.1: The dunes are calm. You move like someone who's listened to sand. Not a compliment I give lightly.
q.SQ-Mural.title: The Lost Mural
q.SQ-Mural.sum: Anwen's team found a mural that shows a single golden figure surrounded by shadows. Find the rest of the wall.
SQ-Mural.offer.1: The mural shows a lone hero, golden, facing a crowd of shadows. I need the rest. I think there's an inscription.
SQ-Mural.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Mural.done.1: There's a name beneath the figure. It's been scratched out. Four letters. The first is 'A'.
q.SQ-Spice.title: Zaira's Rare Spice
q.SQ-Spice.sum: Zaira wants desert bloom for a recipe hidden in the mural.
q.SQ-Spice.o1: Copy the recipe from the mural
SQ-Spice.offer.1: My grandmother's spice blend. The recipe is in a mural in Khemet. Desert bloom is the base. If you find both, I'll cook you something illegal.
SQ-Spice.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Spice.done.1: Smell that. That's four generations of arguments in one pot. Eat.
q.SQ-Well.title: The Poisoned Well
q.SQ-Well.sum: Scorpions are fouling a well outside Qasr Amun.
SQ-Well.offer.1: Water is life. Scorpions don't care. Five of them have made the western well their home. Evict them politely.
SQ-Well.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Well.done.1: Politely, you say? Hm. The well says thank you.
q.SQ-Weave.title: Fatima's Chitin
q.SQ-Weave.sum: Fatima weaves armor from scorpion chitin, if you can supply it.
SQ-Weave.offer.1: Light, strong, ugly. That's chitin armor. I'd weave it for you if I had the plates. You can find them on the desert scorpions.
SQ-Weave.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Weave.done.1: There. A coat that fits like a promise. And a little bit of a stinger, for style.
q.SQ-MountStray.title: Jalil's Stray
q.SQ-MountStray.sum: One of Jalil's sand-striders has wandered into the dunes.
SQ-MountStray.offer.1: My best mare. She bites. She's also family. If you find her, don't try to ride her. Offer her an apple.
SQ-MountStray.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-MountStray.done.1: She likes you. That's worrying. Don't let it go to your head.
q.SQ-Dig.title: Nashu's Dig
q.SQ-Dig.sum: Nashu needs time sand from the tomb wraiths to date a chamber.
q.SQ-Dig.o0: Collect two vials of time sand
SQ-Dig.offer.1: The chamber is four thousand years old. Or four hundred. Or thirty minutes. Time sand tells. Bring me some.
SQ-Dig.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Dig.done.1: Fascinating! It's sixty-three years old. I'm shocked. I'm going to write this up.
q.SQ-Flatbread.title: Sahar's Best Lemonade
q.SQ-Flatbread.sum: Sahar needs flour and spice for her famous flatbread.
q.SQ-Flatbread.o0: Collect four sacks of wild flour
SQ-Flatbread.offer.1: Flatbread: the single dish that makes tourists weep. Flour, spice, patience. I'm out of two of the three.
SQ-Flatbread.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Flatbread.done.1: There. That's the smell of home. Eat before the camels notice.
q.SQ-ScoutWarning.title: The Scout's Warning
q.SQ-ScoutWarning.sum: Idris saw armored footprints near the catacombs and wants the wraiths cleared.
SQ-ScoutWarning.offer.1: Something is waking the dead. I don't know what. I know four wraiths came out of the catacombs last night and one of them waved at me.
SQ-ScoutWarning.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-ScoutWarning.done.1: Thanks. I've never been waved at by a ghost before. I'd like it never to happen again.
q.SQ-Climbers.title: The Stranded Climbers
q.SQ-Climbers.sum: A team is stuck at the Climbers' Camp without supplies.
SQ-Climbers.offer.1: Four of them, stuck above the pass. No food. One broken leg. Bring potions. I'd go myself, but my knees are older than the mountain.
SQ-Climbers.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Climbers.done.1: All four alive. Frostbitten, ungrateful, and alive. I'll take it.
q.SQ-SongsSnow.title: Songs in the Snow
q.SQ-SongsSnow.sum: Elowen hears Isrevna's songs in the Singing Ice and wants to know what she's saying.
SQ-SongsSnow.offer.1: There's a place where the ice resonates. Her songs echo there. I want to know if they're lullabies or pleas.
SQ-SongsSnow.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-SongsSnow.done.1: She sings 'the first light.' Over and over. As if she's waiting for someone to answer.
q.SQ-Lighthouse.title: The Frozen Lighthouse
q.SQ-Lighthouse.sum: Sigrid wants to explore the old lighthouse. It's haunted by ice wraiths.
SQ-Lighthouse.offer.1: The lighthouse hasn't shone for a hundred years. I want to see the lamp. Torvik says no. So obviously we're going.
SQ-Lighthouse.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Lighthouse.done.1: The lamp is still there. Frozen. Beautiful. I took a pebble. For the memory.
q.SQ-SkaldLast.title: Skald's Last Climb
q.SQ-SkaldLast.sum: Torvik asks you to bring something to the Lighthouse in his daughter's memory.
q.SQ-SkaldLast.o0: Leave Torvik's token at the Lighthouse
SQ-SkaldLast.offer.1: My daughter's scarf. I've kept it for ten years. I'd like it left where she fell. I can't climb that high. Will you?
SQ-SkaldLast.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-SkaldLast.done.1: Did the wind take it? Good. She always wanted to fly.
q.SQ-Bell.title: Halvar's Bell
q.SQ-Bell.sum: Halvar needs frost silver to recast the cathedral bell.
SQ-Bell.offer.1: The cathedral bell cracked. It has to be recast, and the only metal that sings right is frost silver. Three pieces. Please.
SQ-Bell.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Bell.done.1: Listen. That's the first clean note I've heard in years. Thank you.
q.SQ-FrostWolves.title: Marek's Wolves
q.SQ-FrostWolves.sum: Frost wolves threaten the Hrimvald patrols.
SQ-FrostWolves.offer.1: Six wolves on the north ridge. My patrols are spread thin. I'd like them thinned before the next snowfall.
SQ-FrostWolves.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-FrostWolves.done.1: All present. Count's good. That's the best news I've had this month.
q.SQ-Broth.title: Gudrun's Stew Stock
q.SQ-Broth.sum: Gudrun needs frostcap and fish for her winter broth.
SQ-Broth.offer.1: Winter's coming. The broth is the only thing that keeps the miners from mutiny. Bring me frostcap and fish.
SQ-Broth.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Broth.done.1: That's the one. Now sit. Eat. You look thin.
q.SQ-Patrol.title: The Silent Patrol
q.SQ-Patrol.sum: Captain Marek's patrol vanished in Whiteout Pass.
q.SQ-Patrol.o0: Search Whiteout Pass for the patrol
q.SQ-Patrol.o1: Free the patrol from the wraiths
SQ-Patrol.offer.1: Six of mine went into the pass four days ago. I'd like them back. Even if it's just their hats.
SQ-Patrol.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Patrol.done.1: All six. Cold. Cranky. Alive. I'm buying the first round.
q.SQ-Fur.title: Sigrid's Warm Coat
q.SQ-Fur.sum: Sigrid needs yeti fur to stitch a coat for a client.
q.SQ-Fur.o0: Gather three pieces of yeti fur
SQ-Fur.offer.1: My client's freezing. I can fix that with three yeti furs. Frost wolves drop them if you're nice about it.
SQ-Fur.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Fur.done.1: Beautiful. Warm as a hug. You'll never be cold again, at least for a week.
q.SQ-ChoirHusks.title: The Choir's Husks
q.SQ-ChoirHusks.sum: Elowen wants the husks of the old choir put to rest.
q.SQ-ChoirHusks.o0: Lay five choir husks to rest
SQ-ChoirHusks.offer.1: They sing sometimes. Not words. A hollow note. I think they're the singers who stayed too long in the silence.
SQ-ChoirHusks.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-ChoirHusks.done.1: They didn't resist. Thank you. I think they were waiting for a kind hand.
q.SQ-Strike.title: Ashen Miners Strike
q.SQ-Strike.sum: The miners' guild has downed tools. Ysolde needs coal moved to keep the city warm.
q.SQ-Strike.o0: Talk to Stoker Magnus about the furnaces
SQ-Strike.offer.1: The strike's a fair one. The city's cold, and my miners are the only ones who understand why. Move coal for them. Then help me argue with the foremen.
SQ-Strike.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Strike.done.1: The strike's settled. Better pay, better lamps. Not perfect. We'll keep shouting.
q.SQ-Anvil.title: The Singing Anvil
q.SQ-Anvil.sum: Brandt says the old anvil in the forgotten forge sings at night.
q.SQ-Anvil.o1: Bring two ember steel ingots to strike on it
SQ-Anvil.offer.1: There's an anvil in the old forge that rings with no hammer. Forge-songs say it was Aurel's. A knight's. A tired knight's.
SQ-Anvil.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Anvil.done.1: It rang when you struck it. Twelve notes. The last one... trails off. Like a man who ran out of breath.
q.SQ-Apprentice.title: Forgemaster's Apprentice
q.SQ-Apprentice.sum: Cinda's first masterwork needs ember steel and iron.
q.SQ-Apprentice.o0: Bring Cinda an ember steel ingot
SQ-Apprentice.offer.1: It's my first real piece. Master Brandt says it has to be perfect. I think it has to be merely good. Can you bring supplies?
SQ-Apprentice.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Apprentice.done.1: It's wonky. It's mine. Brandt didn't laugh. I think that counts.
q.SQ-LavaFish.title: Lava-Fish Special
q.SQ-LavaFish.sum: Vesna's signature dish needs three raw lava-fish.
SQ-LavaFish.offer.1: I catch them myself usually. My back is out. Three. They're in the channels. They bite back. It's good practice.
SQ-LavaFish.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-LavaFish.done.1: Wait. Try this. ...Breathe. Breathe. Drink water. I'm so sorry. It's delicious.
q.SQ-ForgeSong.title: The Forge-Song
q.SQ-ForgeSong.sum: Doro hums the last verse of the forge-song and can't remember how it ends.
q.SQ-ForgeSong.o0: Descend to where the song is loudest
SQ-ForgeSong.offer.1: There's a song in the mines. I know the verses but not the end. If you go down to the lowest gallery and listen, tell me how it ends.
SQ-ForgeSong.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-ForgeSong.done.1: 'And the knight set down his sword, and no one came.' ...That's it? That's the end? Oh. Oh, that's terrible.
q.SQ-Golems.title: Magnus's Fire
q.SQ-Golems.sum: Magnus's furnaces are getting raided by magma golems.
SQ-Golems.offer.1: The golems love my coal. I can't blame them. But it's mine.
SQ-Golems.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Golems.done.1: Two down. Thank you. Now they know there's an angry man behind the shovel.
q.SQ-Imps.title: Ysolde's Shaft
q.SQ-Imps.sum: Ember imps have taken the upper shaft. Ysolde wants them gone.
q.SQ-Imps.o0: Clear six ember imps from the upper shaft
SQ-Imps.offer.1: Little fire gremlins. They're burning the beams. Six of them. And try not to topple the supports.
SQ-Imps.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Imps.done.1: Quiet at last. Supports intact. I'd kiss you if I didn't have a reputation.
q.SQ-Scales.title: Brandt's Armor Order
q.SQ-Scales.sum: Brandt wants magma scales for a commission.
SQ-Scales.offer.1: Magma scale plate takes a special temper. I need three. The golems have them. They don't give them up willingly.
SQ-Scales.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Scales.done.1: Look at that grain. Like a sunset trapped in iron. Take this cuirass off my shelf. It's done.
q.SQ-CoalRun.title: The Coal Run
q.SQ-CoalRun.sum: Magnus needs a coal delivery run before the furnaces fail.
SQ-CoalRun.offer.1: Furnaces are low. Fifteen loads. If we run dry, the whole city goes dark.
SQ-CoalRun.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-CoalRun.done.1: The furnaces roar. I may cry.
q.SQ-Petition.title: The Miners' Petition
q.SQ-Petition.sum: Doro asks you to carry the miners' petition to Ysolde.
SQ-Petition.offer.1: It's three pages, signed by every miner on my shift. Ysolde needs to read it. I don't trust the foremen to deliver it.
SQ-Petition.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Petition.done.1: Ysolde read it. Twice. She's going to the council. I'd cry but I'm saving it for the day it passes.
q.SQ-Defector.title: Cult Defector Nox
q.SQ-Defector.sum: Nox wants the cultists' remains cleaned out of his old hideout.
q.SQ-Defector.o0: Gather five vials of shadow residue
SQ-Defector.offer.1: My old brothers left things. Vials, ledgers, a favorite robe. I want it gone. Bring me the residue so I can burn it properly.
SQ-Defector.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Defector.done.1: There. Ashes. For the first time, I can breathe in here. Take this shard. It was mine. It's yours.
q.SQ-LastLetters.title: Last Letters from the Front
q.SQ-LastLetters.sum: Medic Reyna asks you to collect and deliver soldiers' last letters.
SQ-LastLetters.offer.1: The soldiers write letters before every battle. I carry them. If one of them doesn't come back, I mail it. It's the worst job I do. Help me with the pile.
SQ-LastLetters.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-LastLetters.done.1: There. Sorted. Sealed. I'll mail them tonight. And I'll hope I never have to.
q.SQ-Promise.title: The Soldier's Promise
q.SQ-Promise.sum: Vale swore to protect the gate that he once ran from.
SQ-Promise.offer.1: I ran once. I won't again. If you stand with me, I'll hold. I need someone to see it.
SQ-Promise.progress.1: Still at it? I'll be here when you're done.
SQ-Promise.done.1: I held. Did you see? I held. I think my daughter will hear about this one.
q.BQ-Goblins.title: Bounty: Goblin Cull
q.BQ-Goblins.sum: Guild board: thin the goblin raiders harassing the south road. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Wolves.title: Bounty: Wolf Pack
q.BQ-Wolves.sum: Guild board: wolves are menacing the Whisperwood roads. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Shadows.title: Bounty: Shadow Sweep
q.BQ-Shadows.sum: Guild board: shadow soldiers keep coming back. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Herbs.title: Bounty: Herb Gathering
q.BQ-Herbs.sum: Guild board: the apothecaries need meadow herbs. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Ore.title: Bounty: Ore Haul
q.BQ-Ore.sum: Guild board: the smiths want iron ore. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Scorpions.title: Bounty: Scorpion Sweep
q.BQ-Scorpions.sum: Guild board: scorpions on the Caravan Road. Repeatable.
q.BQ-FrostWolves.title: Bounty: Frost Wolf Hunt
q.BQ-FrostWolves.sum: Guild board: frost wolves threaten Hrimvald's patrols. Repeatable.
q.BQ-Imps.title: Bounty: Imp Extermination
q.BQ-Imps.sum: Guild board: ember imps in the Ashen Mines. Repeatable.
